src_text: This are the first steps to keeping your family safe from Covid 19; 1.Wash your hands regularly with soap & running water 2. Cover your mouth and nose with a flexed elbow or tissue, when coughing or sneezing. 3.Avoid close contact with anyone who has cold or flu-like symptoms

src_text: Alcohol and Smoking will increase the risks of having high blood pressure. While you STAY AT HOME reduce alcohol intake and smoking.

src_text: Be safe from coronavirus.Washing your hands is the most important way to stop transmission. 1.Wet hands 2.Apply enough soap 3.Scrub all surfaces of the hands for 20-30 seconds. 4.Rinse thoroughly with running water 5.Dry hands with a clean cloth or single-use towel
tgt_text: Etange n’ebinyinyi bia Corona. Gosibia amaboko nenchera ya bene yogotanga ogoetia kwebinyinyi. 1.Esibi amaboko 2.Eyake esabuni 3.Sugua kera ensemo yokoboko ase chisekunde 20-30 4.Sibi amaboko ase amache egetacho 5.Etinyi n’egetambaa ekerabu

src_text: How to boost your immune system against the COVID-19; 1. Stay hydrated - drink 3-4 litres of water daily. 2. Take antioxidant-rich diet - amla, guava, green leafy veggies, spinach, garlic, green tea, peppers, turmeric 3. Exercise 4. Meditation 5. Quality sleep
tgt_text: Enchera yokomenta ogwetanga korwa Covid 19 1.Kanywe amache amange - chilita 3-4 kera rituko 2.Kari chindagera buna amapera, chinyeni chiekegusii, egetunguo saumu, n.k 3.Tarataria omobere 4.Okoiranerera 5.Chitoro chiisaine

src_text: You have to be registered to get the COVID-19 vaccine. You can do this at the nearest health facility or be registering on the MOH_Kenya website (http://health.go.ke). All you need is your ID card. Kindly assist your elderly relatives to get registered

src_text: A small number of vaccinated people may get infected with COVID-19 after vaccination; this is called a breakthrough infection, but they are likely to have milder symptoms than if they were not vaccinated.

src_text: All COVID-19 vaccines are safe for use by adults, breastfeeding mothers and as per current WHO guidelines, can also be used by pregnant women upon recommendation by a qualified physician.

src_text: Taking different types of vaccines is not recommended. After being fully vaccinated you will obtain your COVID-19 certificate from the MOH website https://portal.health.go.ke.

src_text: Key causes of TB include undernutrition, HIV, alcohol use disorders, smoking, and diabetes. Get the word out! We can eradicate TB together
tgt_text: Esese nigo ekorentwa na ogotaragera buya, enyamoreo, obotindu bwa amaru, esigara amo noborwaire bwesukari. Raria eng’ana eye! Ase oboamo nabo togokora esese

src_text: Coughing! Fever! Night sweats! Chest pains! Weight loss! You could have TB. Testing and treatment are free at all public hospitals!Get tested today!

tgt_text: Erio obwene esese, goika okore oborwaria buna ogosemigwa nomonyagitaro oo.

src_text: Key points to stop Mpox spread: Avoid close contact with individuals showing symptoms. Do not share personal items like towels, utensils, or clothing. Maintain good hygiene by washing hands frequently.
tgt_text: Amang’ana yengencho yogotanga Mpox: Tiga goikana ang’e nabanto babwate ebimanyererio bioborwaire obo. Timosanga ebinto bia ime buna chitauro, ebinto biendagera, gose chianga. Kaba omochenu ase ogwesibi amaboko ao kera chingaki.

src_text: Mpox symptoms include fever, rash, and swollen lymph nodes. Seek medical care immediately if you notice any of these.

src_text: Mental Health Check-Up Time!Mental Health Check-Up Time! Your mental health is just as important as your physical health. Take a moment to check in with yourself today. 1. src_text: This Mens Mental Health Awareness Month, lets break the silence. Society often tells men to "be strong," but real strength lies in acknowledging your struggles and reaching out. 1. Speaking up isnt weaknessits courage. 2. Your feelings are valid. 3.You dont have to face it alone. Whether its stress, anxiety, depression, or just feeling overwhelmed your mental health matters. Talk to a friend, a counselor, or a support group. src_text: Stressed about money? Dont gamble with your mental health! When finances feel overwhelming, its tempting to chase "quick fixes" like gambling or substance usebut these only make things worse. Instead, take control by seeking free financial counseling and building healthy money habits. Your mental health matters. Choose smart solutions over short-term risks.

Ribaka riaye rigia chinguru chi'okorigia obomanyi bwe chibesa otari gwakanera na koagacha chingencho chingiya chie chibesa.. Afya yao y'obongo ney'engencho. Chora chinchera chingiya kobua obokongu bw'engaki enke.

src_text: Consider therapy or counseling. A mental health professional can provide strategies to cope with stigma and help you develop a positive self-image
tgt_text: Rengereria obogwenia gose ogokwanerwa kw’obosemia. Omomanyi bw’oborwaria bw'obongo nabo akorwa chinchera chi'okorwania obokongu obo na gokonya kwemanya buya aye omonyene.

src_text: Understanding mental health issues can empower you to challenge misconceptions. Share accurate information with friends and family to promote awareness and reduce stigma
tgt_text: Koba n'obomanyi bw'amangana y’oborwaria bw'obongo nkonyare kogokonya gokona ebirengererio bio gosiria. Sanga chinkwana chingiya na abasani na efamilia egere ekinie koigwanana na gokeania esekererio.

src_text: Communities can come together to support individuals facing both mental health issues and substance use challenges through several strategies
tgt_text: Chiamate nabo chigocha amo ase kobakonya abanto babwate emechando ya afya y'obongo na obokong'u bw'amariogo yogotindi goetera emeroberio emenge.

src_text: Ensure there are confidential channels for employees to seek mental health support without fear of retaliation or judgment
tgt_text: Enekia ng'a chinchera chi'ibobisia nchireo ase abakori emeremo korigia obokonyi bw'afya y'obongo batari na obwoba bw'ogoakana egesiomba gose gosibu.

src_text: Make sure employees are aware of resources available to them, such as Employee Assistance Programs (EAPs), mental health hotlines, or counseling services
tgt_text: Enekia ng'a abakori emeremo mbamanyete chintobokia chiobokonyi chikonyorekana ase bare, buna omoroberio bw'obokonyi ase abakori emeremo (eaps), chisimi chia bwango chi'afya y'obongo gose obokoreri bw'okomanyigwa kwa oboikeranu.

src_text: As Kenya records rising malaria cases due to climate variability, the just ended World Malaria Day serves as a critical reminder of the need to transform public health initiatives to meet these evolving challenges
tgt_text: Kenya kegendererete korika okomentakana gw’esosera ekorentwa n'obwonchoreria bw'embeo, Rituko Riesosera Ense Engima erio rierete bwango iga nigo rigotumeka buna okoinyora obuya bw'okogania go'onchora emeroberio y'eafya y'abanto bonsi egere enyare korwani amakong'u aya agendererete.

tgt_text: Eriogo ri’esosera erio riatemetwe Kenya riancheranirwe na WHO

src_text: WHO approves second malaria jab for children, to cost as low as Sh300
tgt_text: WHO yancheranire okoegwa eriogo ria kabere ria esosera ase abana, koba ne rigori ria inse ya sh. 300

src_text: Womens mental health can be influenced by hormonal changes related to the menstrual cycle, pregnancy, and menopause. Substance use can disrupt these hormonal balances, potentially intensifying mental health symptoms
tgt_text: Afya y'obongo bwa abakungu nabo bogoturubanigwa na amaonchoreri yo obonyamasi bokobwaterana na okorora erangi, oborito na gotiga korora erangi. Ogotumekwa kwa amariogo yo ogotindi nobo kogoturubani ebirengo abio bio obonyamasi na komenta okororekana koba ne emechando y'eafya y'obongo.

src_text: Long-term substance use can impair cognitive functions such as memory and decision-making, which can further complicate mental health issues and affect daily functioning
tgt_text: Ogotumeka kwa amariogo y'ogotindi ase chingaki chintambe nabo agosaria okomanya obokori egasi emeremo buna okoinyora na gokora okonacha koramente obokongu bw'eafya y'obongo na gosaria obokori bw'emeremo ya kira rituko.

src_text: Goal-setting is subjective. It is important to create goals that make sense for you during your recovery journey. If you need assistance in creating realistic and achievable goals, reach out to your mentor, peer, or another mental health professional for guidance and tips
tgt_text: Kobeka ebirenga n’engana ya bene. N’egento ki engencho korosia ebirenga bikogwenerete ekero ore a se esabari y’okogwena. Onye g otagete obokonyi korosia ebirenga ebiya bigoikereka, rigia omosemia oo, oyomino, gose omomanyi onde b w’oborwaria, gose omomanyi b w’oborwaria bw’obongo omomanyi, orakoe obomanyi.

src_text: Look at your family history of mental illness and addiction, several studies have shown that this disease tends to run in the family, but can be prevented. The more you are aware of your biological, environmental and physical risk factors the more likely you are to overcome them
tgt_text: Rigereria omogano bw'oborwaire bw'obongo amo nokonarereria ase enyomba yaino, obotuki obonge bwaorokirie ng'a oborwaire obo nigo bogotara ase enyomba, korende nabo bogotangwa. Buna okomanya mono igoro y'amang’ana aya are n’obobe ase oboibori, ase obomenyo, na ase omobere, nario oramanye enchera yokoyabua.

src_text: Develop routines for nutrition, exercise, and sleep. This promotes physical and mental health, contributing to a balanced lifestyle.
tgt_text: Rosia chinchera chiokoragera okuya, gokora amasoesi na korara. Eye nigo egokinia oborwaria bw'omobere n'obongo, erio gosiira komenya obogima oboikeranu.

src_text: Expectant mothers are urged to start antenatal care visits during the first trimester of pregnancy to monitor both mother and babys health. Early check-ups help identify risks and ensure safe delivery.
tgt_text: Abasubati bebwateranetie basoroirwe gochaka kogenda ekeriniki ase emetienyi emetang’ani etato y’oborito, erio korenga afya y’omwana na ng’ina

src_text: Health centers are offering free iron and folic acid supplements to all pregnant women to prevent anemia and birth defects. Visit your nearest facility today.
tgt_text: Ebitaseni bi'obogwenia bono nkoenana bire amadini y'echuma na foliki ase abang'ina bonsi bebwateranetie erio gotanga Anemia/ogokeea kw'amanyinga omobere na gotanga oborema bw'okoiborwa. Tarera egetaseni ki'obogwenia kere ang'e naye rero.

src_text: All deliveries should be conducted by skilled birth attendants at health facilities. This ensures safer births and immediate care in case of complications.
tgt_text: Okoiborigwa kogwenerete gokoru na'bamanyi ase chinyagitari .Eye nigo ekoenekia okoiboirigwa okuya na obokonyi bwa bwango obokong'u boisa kobao

src_text: Mothers are advised to exclusively breastfeed their babies for the first six months without giving water or food. Breastmilk provides all the nutrients and protection a baby needs.
tgt_text: Abang’ina nigo bakoborigwa kogonkia abaana babo amabere ooka ase emetienyi etano nomo batari kobaa amache gose endagera. Amabere ayokogonkigwa nigo akoa omwana amadini onsi amo na oborendi atakaeire gotwara.

src_text: All pregnant women are encouraged to create a birth preparedness plan including identifying a health facility, arranging transport, and saving funds.
tgt_text: Abakungu bonsi bebwateranetie nigo bairwe omoyo barosie omopango bwo’gochi kobiara, amo na gochora enyagitari, kobanga esafari na kogacha chibesa .

src_text: Caregivers should follow the national immunization schedule to protect children against deadly diseases such as measles, polio, and tuberculosis.
tgt_text: Abareri nigo bagwenerete kobwatia omoroberio bw'ense bw'echanjo erio korenda abana korwa ase amarwaire amabe buna measles, polio na Esese

src_text: For low birth weight babies, Kangaroo Mother Care  skin-to-skin contact  is recommended to regulate body temperature, improve breastfeeding, and boost survival.
tgt_text: Ase abana bari baiboire nechikiro chinke,Huduma ya Mama ya Kangaroo - ogokunana kw'omobere nkoganeirie erio komenta riberera riomobere,okogonka okuya, na komenta obogima.

src_text: Mothers and newborns should attend postnatal check-ups within 48 hours after birth to detect any complications and promote healthy recovery.
tgt_text: Abang'ina amo n'abana abake bagwenerete kogenda oborengi nyagitari chinsa 48 koru okoibora banyare korengwa erio korigia bobe bonde bwonsi na korotota okobwena kwa bwango.

src_text: Pregnant women are encouraged to sleep under insecticide-treated nets and take preventive medication to avoid malaria, which poses risks to both mother and baby.
tgt_text: Abakungu bebwateraneti nigo bagosegetwa korara ime yechineti chirwariri goita chiumbu, na konyora amariogo yogotanga Esosera eywo ekobeka omwana na ng'ina ase abe.

src_text: Men are encouraged to accompany their partners to antenatal clinics and support them during pregnancy and after childbirth. Male involvement improves outcomes.
tgt_text: Abasacha baborigwe kogenda n'abakungu babo ase chikliniki na kobakonya ekero bebwateraneirie na ekero baiboire abana. Okoba aroro kw'abasacha nigo kogokinia amatokeo.

src_text: Pregnant women should consume a balanced diet rich in iron, protein, and vitamins to support fetal development and maternal health.
tgt_text: Abakungu bebwateranetie mbagwenerete koria chindagera chireng’anirie, chibwate amadini y’echuma, chiproteini, amo na evitamini erio gosiira okoba buya kw’omwana ore inda, n’oborwaria bw’oborito.

src_text: Children aged 1 to 5 should be dewormed every six months to prevent worm infections that can lead to malnutrition and stunted growth.
tgt_text: Abana b’omwaka 1 goika 5 mbagwenerete gosibigwa ebianda ase kera emetienyi etano n’omo, erio gotanga okoambokeria kw’ebianda ebio biranyare korenta enchara na ogotakina buya.

src_text: Caregivers are advised to keep the umbilical cord clean and dry. Do not apply substances like ash or herbs as they may cause infections.
tgt_text: Abareri nigo baborigwe korenda ekenyogu ki'omwana kebe ekerabu naende gekamogete. Mbabaisa goaka ebinto buna ribu gose emete yorosana ekiagera nigo birarente amarwaire

src_text: Communities should educate and support adolescents to avoid early pregnancies through life skills, counseling, and access to reproductive health services.
tgt_text: Eamate negwenerete okegeria na gokoonya abana abasae gotanga oborito bwa mapema goetera kobaegeria obomanyi bw'obogima, obosemia, na goikera oborwari bw'oroiboro.

src_text: Children under five should receive vitamin A drops every six months to boost immunity and reduce child mortality.
tgt_text: Abana bare nse y'emiaka etano baganerigwe konyora amadini a Vitamini A ya monu kera emetienyi etano n'omo, erio korenda ogokina kwomwana na gokei amakweri

src_text: Some cultural practices during pregnancy and childbirth may endanger lives. Communities are urged to adopt evidence-based health practices.
tgt_text: Chingencho chinde chia kare ekero giokwebwaterani amo na okoibora nabo bikobeka amagima akong’u . Eamate yasoroirwe koegia chingencho chi’oborwaria chienekirie.

src_text: Caregivers should wash hands with soap before handling babies, after changing diapers, and before feeding to prevent infections.
tgt_text: Abareri nigo babwenerete gosibia amaboko amo n’esabuni, batarabwata abana, ekero bakorire kobarusia ebitangachabu na ekero batarabarageria erinde gotanga chindwari.

src_text: Fast breathing and chest indrawing in children may signal pneumonia. Seek medical care immediately.
tgt_text: Okoeyana bwango, na okong'usa egekuba gochia ime ase abana nabo korabe ekemanyererio gi’ekeuno/nimonia. Rigia okorwarigwa bwango.

src_text: Parents should register the birth of their child at the nearest civil registration office. A birth certificate secures a childs legal identity and access to services.
tgt_text: Abaibori mbagwenerete korikia okoibora Kwa abana babo ase obisi ya korikia ere ang'e. Esatibigeti ya okoibora nigo ekorenda richiko riokomanyekana kw’omwana na konyora obokoreri.

src_text: Delivering at home without skilled help puts both mother and baby at risk. Always deliver at a health facility with trained personnel.
tgt_text: Okoiborera nka otabwati obokonyi bw’omomanyi nigo gokobeka omwana na ng’ina ase obobe. Botambe, iborera nyagitari ase abakori emeremo abamanyi bare basomerete.

src_text: Pregnant women living with HIV should attend clinic early to receive antiretroviral therapy and prevent transmission to the baby.
tgt_text: Abakungu abare morito, naende bamenyete na ebirusi bia HIV,nigo babwenerete gochaka ekeriniki mapema banyore amariogo ya ogokeiyia ebirusi bia Enyamoreo, na gotanga okoambokeria Omwana.

src_text: Pregnant women in their second trimester should receive deworming medication to improve nutrition and reduce complications.
tgt_text: Abang’ina abageni nigo bakoegwa omoyo, gokwanera okobanga oroiboro amo na abakoreri na abamanyi erinde korwa ribaga risaine ase oborito erio koenekia okogwena buya ekero baiboire.

src_text: New mothers are encouraged to discuss family planning options with health providers to allow proper spacing of pregnancies and ensure maternal recovery.
tgt_text: Abang’ina abageni baairwe omoyo, gotwara enkwanaigoro y’okobanga oroiboro amo na abakoreri b’oborwari, erio korwa ribaga risaine ase okoba morito na koenekia okogwena ekero baiboire

src_text: Adolescent mothers need extra emotional, nutritional, and medical support. Communities are urged to reduce stigma and promote inclusive care.
tgt_text: Abang'ina abasae mbaganatie obokonyi bwa ebirengererio,endagera na oborwaria.Ebisaku biasabirwe gokeia oboiroku na gosira oborendi bwa amo.

src_text: Pregnant women should receive tetanus toxoid vaccination to protect themselves and their babies from neonatal tetanus.
tgt_text: Abasubati bebwateranetie mbaganeirie konyora esindani ya tetanus erinde koerenda amo na abana korua ase endwari eyio ya tetanus.

src_text: New mothers experiencing sadness, withdrawal, or hopelessness should seek mental health support. Postpartum depression is treatable.
tgt_text: Abasubati bagonkirie na koigwa kobea, kobera are na abanto na gosiria ogosemeria mbabwenerete korigia obokonyi na gosiirwa ase ebirengererio. Oborwaire bwa ebirengererio kobwatia okogonkia nkorwarigwa bore na kogwena.

src_text: Regular weight checks at clinics help detect growth issues early. Caregivers are encouraged to attend monthly child welfare clinics.
tgt_text: Okorengwa kwa botambe kw’oborito ase ekliniki nigo kogokonya komanya obokong'u mapema. Abareri babekirwe chinguru bagende ekeriniki Kia ogokina Kwa abana kera omotienyi

src_text: A toll-free maternal health helpline is available for advice and emergency referrals. Dial 1195 anytime.
tgt_text: Esimi ya okonyora obokonyi ase abasubati bakogonkia,nere aroro ase okoegwa obosemia na gokonywa Kwa obwango. Aka 1195 chinsa chinde chionsi

src_text: Families are encouraged to identify emergency transport options in advance, in case labor begins unexpectedly. Delays in reaching the hospital can lead to complications.
tgt_text: Chinyomba chiairwe omoyo korigia enchera y'obosombi mapema, Obororo Bwa okoibora kiborache mobasokano. Okonyorwa goika nyagitari Nabo gokoreta emechando.

src_text: Mothers who express breast milk should ensure clean containers, proper refrigeration, and correct warming procedures to prevent contamination.
tgt_text: Abang'ina bari bagokamera abana amabere, nigo babwenerete koenekia ng'a ebinto bi'okobekerera mbisibirie, okogacha buya ase efriji na kobwatia buya erinde gotanga ogotiringa.

src_text: A high fever in a child could be a sign of malaria or infection. Visit the nearest clinic without delay to prevent complications.
tgt_text: Rikuba ritindi ase omwana nabo rirabe ekemanyererio kiesosera gose okoambokerigwa. Tarera enyomba y'oboringoria ere ange naye otari konyorwa erio otange obokong'u obwo.

src_text: Postpartum women should take deworming medication to improve nutrition and milk quality.
tgt_text: Abakungu mbabwenerete gotumeka amariogo yogoita ebianda ekero baiboire nario barakongie endagera n'obuya bw'amabere.

src_text: Babies under six months get all the hydration they need from breast milk. Giving water increases infection risk.
tgt_text: Abana abare inse yemetienyi etano noyomo nigo bakonyora amache onsi ayare aganeirie korwa ase amabere akorwa ase abangina. Kobaa amache nigo gokomenta obokong'u bokwambokerigwa.

src_text: Sleeping under insecticide-treated nets protects expectant mothers and their unborn babies from malaria.
tgt_text: Korara ime yechineti chisibirie namariogo yogoita chinkoromba nigo chikorenda abasubati bare barito na abana babo bataraiborwa korwa ase esosera.

src_text: Swollen feet, thin limbs, or constant fatigue in a child may be signs of malnutrition. Seek help immediately.
tgt_text: Amagoro abimbete, amagoro amanyerere gose okorosa gwa kera chinsa ase omwana nabo erabe ekiorokererio kia okorwara. Rigia obokonyi bwango.

src_text: Do not apply substances to the cord. Keep it dry and clean until it falls off naturally.
tgt_text: Tobaisa goaka ebinto binde bionsi ase omogoyo. Onyebeke ebe enkamoku naende endabu goika egwe yoka.

src_text: Severe headaches, swelling, or bleeding during pregnancy require immediate medical attention.
tgt_text: Ogoatigwa ogotindi kw'omotwe, okobimba gose amanyinga korwa chingaki chia oborito nkoganetie oborwari bwa bwango kegima.

src_text: Always keep your childs health card and birth certificate safe for school, healthcare, and legal needs.
tgt_text: Botambe gacha risakara ri’oborwaria ri'omwana oo, na risakara riokoiborwa buya ase amagania y'esukuru, chingaki ch'okorwarigwa ne'richiko ri ense.

src_text: New mothers may experience sadness or anxiety. Counseling and support groups can help.
tgt_text: Abasubati abageni ase oboibori nabo bakonyora omoichano gose obwoba. Gokwanerwa okuya n'ebiombe bie obokonyi nabo kogokonya.

src_text: If your child is not sitting, crawling, or speaking by the expected age, visit a pediatric clinic for evaluation
tgt_text: Onye omwana oo taraikaransa, tari kwagora, gose tari gokwana ase chingaki chibwenerete, tarera enyagitari y'abana igere onyore obomanyi.

src_text: Expectant mothers are strongly advised to avoid all alcohol. Drinking during pregnancy can lead to fetal alcohol syndrome and developmental delays.
tgt_text: Abasubati bebwateranete baborigwe mono gotigana amarwa. Gotinda ekere ki'oborito nabo ekoreta oborwaire bw'amarwa naboigo gotebania ogokina kw'omwana otaraiborwa.

src_text: Hormonal changes during pregnancy can affect oral health. Visit a dentist for check-ups and maintain oral hygiene.
tgt_text: Ogoonchoka kw'obonyamasi chingaki chi'oroiboro nabo korarente obokong'u ase afya y'omonwa. Motarere omoringori bwa amaino egere origererigwe nainde orende obochenu bwa omonwa.

src_text: Yellowing of the skin and eyes in newborns should be checked by a health worker. Severe jaundice can affect brain development.
tgt_text: Risankwa amo n'amaiso y'abana ebingwerere kagwansa koba mayaye nkobwenerete korigererigwa n'omokori emeremo onyagitari. Rikuba ritindi riamayaye nabo rigosaria ogokina kw'obongo.

src_text: Health facilities offer family planning counseling to couples and individuals to support informed decisions about spacing and limiting births.
tgt_text: Chnyagitari nkorwa chire amaorokererio amaya yo obonyomba ase abanyuomaine na abanto bande bonsi egere gokonya ogochora okuya igoro yeribaga na gokei oboibori.

src_text: Caregivers should change diapers frequently and clean the babys skin gently to avoid rashes and infections.
tgt_text: Abareri mbabwenerete kobaonchoreri abana ebitangachabu kera chingaki na gosibia amasankwa ya abana ng'oora nario batange amarwairea yerisankwa n'okoambokeria.

src_text: Pregnant women should eat small meals several times a day to manage nausea and maintain energy levels.
tgt_text: Abasubati bebwateranete mbabwenerete koria chindagera chinke chinke kera chingaki ase rituko egere gotanga ekiegeso na goikerania ebirengo bie chunguru chiomobere.

src_text: Using simple hand signs helps babies express needs early, reducing frustration for both caregiver and child.
tgt_text: Gotumia ebiorokererio bi'amaboko nigo egokonya abana abake komanya eki baganeti bwango, erio gokei obokongu ase omoreri n'omwana .

src_text: Mothers are urged to visit immunization booths during market days for convenient access to childhood vaccines.
tgt_text: Abang'ina baborigwe goika ase ebituo biechisindani chia abana amatuko y'echiro koenekia konyora bwango chisindani chiabana

src_text: New mothers can begin light exercises after consulting their doctor to improve recovery and mental health.
tgt_text: Abang'ina abake mbagwenerete bachake gokora ebisaisi ebigusu agusu nyuma yokorora omonyagitari obo erio koenekia okogwena kwa bwango amo na oborwaria bw'obongo.

src_text: Handwashing with soap before feeding and after diaper changes prevents infections in children and mothers.
tgt_text: Gwesibia amaboko nesabuni otaragera na ekero ogoonchoreria ebisena biomwana ngotanga ere kwambokera ebinyinyi ase abana na abangina

src_text: Keeping newborns in skin-to-skin contact with mothers helps regulate temperature, heartbeat, and supports immune development.
tgt_text: Kobeka ebingwerere risankwa ase risankwa ria ngina ngokonya ere korengani riberera, ogoaka gwenkoro na gokonya obonyamasi gokina

src_text: Deworming children every six months improves their growth, energy levels, and school performance.
tgt_text: Goita ebianda asè ebingwerere kera emetienyi etano nomo ngosegeta kore ogokina, ebirengo biechinguru na gokora buya amasomo

src_text: Pregnant women should start antenatal care in the first trimester to detect and manage any health concerns early.
tgt_text: Abangina baberegete goika bachake ebiriniki ataraibora ase emetienyi etato kobwatekani korora kogayana bokongu bonde borabeo

src_text: Help children understand the arrival of a new sibling to reduce jealousy and promote bonding.
tgt_text: Konya abana bamanye ogotoka kwa abana bande bamwabo erio gokeani engareka na gotingia okoigwanana

src_text: Mobile health clinics bring vital prenatal and postnatal services closer to remote communities.
tgt_text: Chinyagitari chiogotara nkorenta chire obokoreri bwengencho omwana ataràiborwa na nyuma àiboirwe ange ase ebinyoro

src_text: Working mothers can express and store breast milk to ensure continued breastfeeding support while away.
tgt_text: Abàngina bakogonkia nabo bagokàma àmabere na koyagacha abanà bagenederere kogonka nonya nekero bare are

src_text: Babies born before 37 weeks require warmth, feeding support, and regular health checkups for proper development.
tgt_text: Ebingwerere bibooire inse yamatuko emerongo etato na etano nebere mbaganetie ribrera, gokonyu koragera na okorengwa kwàbwango kweneki ogokinà okuya

src_text: Men,its okay to talk about your mental health.Speaking up is a sign of strength.
tgt_text: Abasacha, mbuya gokwana igoro yobochenu bwobongo Ogokwana nekemanyererio gia chinguru

src_text: Taking time for yourself is not a luxury, it's a necessity. Remember to prioritize your mental, emotional, and physical health.
tgt_text: Koira chiangaki aseogwekorera tari gosaria chingaki, mboronge Inyora koa ribaga ritangani ebirengereri biago, oboitongo na chigosori

src_text: Did you know suicide is the 3rd leading cause of death among 15-29 year olds? Its time to raise awareness and support mental health.
tgt_text: Nomanyete okoengete nakwo okwa gatato gotàngaine gokorenta amakweri egati ya abànto bare emiaka ikomi na etàno goika emerongo ebere na kianda? Chingaki chiabeire togosemia na gokonya obochenu bwobongo

src_text: This Fathers Day, lets shine a light on mens mental health. To all the dads out there, your well-being matters. Take time to prioritize your mental health and reach out for support when needed.
tgt_text: Riruko eri ria'abatata, tigà tomorekere obochenu bwobongo ase abagàka Ase abatata bonsi, koba kwao buya nokwengecho Ira ribaga rinene ase obochenu bwobongo na korigia ogokonya ekero koganeirie

src_text: You are not alone. Reach out to loved ones or mental health professionals for support.

src_text: Disasters disproportionately affect people with disabilities. Families should plan accessible evacuation routes in advance.
tgt_text: Emesabeka no nigo ere omochando omonene ase abanto bare noborema.Abanto benyomba eyemo nere buya koroberia igoro yenchera yogwekonya baranyare goetera nyuma yomobasekano oyio.

src_text: Survivors of disasters often face trauma. Free counseling is available at government health centers and through NGOs.
tgt_text: Abatigari bemebasekano chingaki chinyinge nigo bakweiranana.Obotebereria na obokonyi bwa bosa mboreo ase chinyagitari chieserikari na goetera ebiombe biria bitari bieserikari(NGOs).

src_text: Drought-affected families can access government relief food. Report hunger cases to the National Drought Management Authority.
tgt_text: Baria banyorirwe nomochando bweguragura enene nabo bakonyora endagera korwa eserikari.Karwe amang'ana igoro yabanto bare nchara gochia eserikari ensemo ya baria batenenerete ogokonya igoro yokorwa obokonyi chingaki chieguragura enene.

src_text: Homes and schools in disaster-prone areas should meet safety standards to withstand floods, earthquakes, and storms.
tgt_text: Chinka nechisukuru chire chingongo chiriachibwate rinaga rinene ria emechando goika chitwatre oborendi bore igoro konua emetengecho nee chikoba

src_text: Counties have designated evacuation centers. Locate your nearest shelter and keep emergency kits ready.
tgt_text: Counties chibegete chinsemo chio obotamero bera ange nase ayie beka ebinto bio'bokonyi ang'e.

src_text: After floods, water sources may be contaminated. Use water purification tablets or boil water before drinking.
tgt_text: Nyuma yetoigo,chisoko chia amache nabo chirasareke tumia chitetere chia ogosibia amache ose oberie.

src_text: Subscribe to SMS alerts from the Meteorological Department to receive real-time flood warnings in your area.
tgt_text: Erike nomoroberio oria okorwa ogokurera igoro bwabsemi berire erio konyora ogosemia kwa beene igoro yembura eneene egocha netoigo ase ekenyoro kiao.

src_text: Local committees help coordinate rescue efforts and resource distribution during emergencies. Volunteer with your village committee.
tgt_text: Chikomiti chi nka ase okomanyania na kobwaterana igoro yobokonyi na kobga obokonyi chinaki chiomobasekano.Erwe gokomora emeremo yokwerwa.

src_text: Improper handling of corpses risks disease outbreaks. Follow Textlines from health authorities during mass fatalities.
tgt_text: Enhera etabwenereti buna etugo ekwete egotindekwa nenchera eyemo yogwateka kwendwari.Bwatita ayarikire korwa baria bakoraa obochenu ekero endwari yatekire.

src_text: Livestock are critical for livelihoods. Report distressed animals to veterinary officers for feed and medical support.
tgt_text: Etugo negento iiengencho ase endangera.Manyia abanyagitari betugo yetugo eria ere ase obokong'u kobwenia nagochirageria amo nobokonyi boganeirie.

src_text: Use flashlights instead of candles to prevent fires during blackouts. Report downed power lines to Kenya Power.
tgt_text: Tumia chitoci ase oborabu erio gotanga ogwateka kwomorero ekero esitima etaiyo.Manyia abanto besitima igoro yemerande yesitima eyio egwete inse.

src_text: Companies should have continuity plans, backup generators, and employee safety training for emergencies.
tgt_text: Chikampani nchibwenerete koba nomoroberio bwokogenderera,koba nebinto buna chichenereta chiomorero,na gosimia abakori emerebo baye igoro yemebasekano.

src_text: Internally Displaced Persons (IDPs) are vulnerable to diseases. Ensure clean water, sanitation, and medical supplies in camps.
tgt_text: Abanto baria baseretigwe korwa ase bare gokora emeremo ekero kieminano yechikura chibopresidenti omwaka 2007/2008 na korenta egegi embe yebiama biegesiasa nebisaku, igo ere obwororo ase bare konyorwa namarwaire. Bakonye konyora amache amaya, chichoo, namariogo aaria chikambi chiabo.

src_text: Improper generator use causes carbon monoxide poisoning. Operate generators outdoors and away from windows.
tgt_text: Gotumia echenereta etarosirie buya namakanika esambe ediseli gose epetiroli buya ekero okoyetumia konyora chunguru chiesuitima nigo egosokia erioki ribabwate esumu ekero kwayeeyanire yaba esumu ase omobere oo. Okia echenereta are korwa ase emerangu nechitirisa erioki tirisoa nyoma.

src_text: Trained volunteers assist in rescue operations. Register with Kenya Red Cross or local disaster committees.
tgt_text: Tabanto begeirie bokwerwa nigo bagokonya ekero kiemesekano. Erike byuna oyomo obo nekeombe ekebariri (Red Cross) gose ecomiti eria yanka eusikaine nemeremo eyio.

src_text: During prolonged disasters, preserve food by drying, salting, or using airtight containers to avoid spoilage.
tgt_text: Ekero kiechando emetambe buna omogaso gose embura enyinge, gacha endagera ase okoyiomia, koyebeka omonyo, goge koyesiba ime yebibekerero embeo etari gosoa ime koyerenda tegunda.

src_text: Rumors worsen panic. Rely on official updates from government agencies and verified media outlets.
tgt_text: Amangana oborimo nigo akogesa obororo. Nyora amangana korwa aase aronge buna eserikari amo nabariki na abamanyi amangana bokwegenwa.

src_text: Snakes seek shelter in homes during floods. Use torches at night and avoid walking barefoot.
tgt_text: Chingiti ching'enda'nse origia chire obomenyo chinka chiaito ekero chietoigo. Tumia etochi botuko na erende gotatacha inse namagoro amasa aotabegeti ebiato.

src_text: Vulnerable families can access government cash aid during disasters via mobile money platforms.
tgt_text: Chifamiri chiria chitari kwenyara gose chintaka mbwango konyorwa nemechando, tema goikera ogokonya gweserikari goetera omoroberio (o'cash aid) ekero kiemechando goetera esimi yao.

src_text: Avoid rebuilding in landslide-prone areas. Government offers alternative land for affected families.
tgt_text: Tiga koirorera kwoagacha ase riroba rikoanyoka. Eserikari nkorwa ere emegondo emao ase oyio oo ase chifamilia chianyorirwe nomochando oyio.

src_text: Free fire safety training is available for communities to prevent and respond to fire outbreaks.
tgt_text: Amasomo abosa igoro yokwerenda ekero kiomorero nareo ase ebinyoro gotanga nagokonya chingaki omorero ogwateka.

src_text: Farmers should adopt drought-resistant crops and water conservation techniques to mitigate climate shocks.
tgt_text: Nere buya ase abaremi gosimeka ebimeri bikoremereria omogaso omnene amo nenchera yokogacha na gotumia buya amache na gotanga konyorwa gose gokeania konyorwa nemechando eyio .

src_text: Learn to build temporary shelters using locally available materials for displaced families.
tgt_text: Egera koacha chinyomba ogtumia ebinto bigotoka inka ase bari baseretigwe korwa aase bare abwo nyuma.

src_text: Learn to recognize trauma symptoms and provide psychological first aid to disaster survivors.
tgt_text: Tema komanya buna obwoba gose ogwechanda kwa abanto banyorirwe nomobasekano erio kobakonya korwania obwoba obwo goetera obosemia bwebirengererio na kobasira nchera ende yonsi erio banyare gotenenana kogenderera.

src_text: Ensure LPG cylinders are stored in well-ventilated areas and check for leaks regularly.
tgt_text: Rora ng'a omotungi bwegasi yokorugera mbuya egachiire na aase agiya are nerigaba riembeo gosoa ime, na rigereria kera chingaki komanya gose egasi nkominchoria ere korwa omotungi oyesokie bwango buna enchera eyemo yogotanga emebasekano.

src_text: Older adults need tailored evacuation plans. Identify caregivers and accessible shelters in advance.
tgt_text: Abanto abagotu mbaganetie enchera yabeene kobatamia korwa emebasekano. Beka abatenereri babo amo nase oraibaire kobera motwe yokobatania korwa omobasekano.

src_text: Chemicals and fuels should be stored away from homes to prevent fires and environmental contamination.
tgt_text: Chikemiko naguta nere buya kogachwa are korwa chinka na ase engencho ebwenerete eri ogotanga ogwateka kwemerero na ogosaria amasingira.

src_text: Lost family members can be traced through Kenya Red Cross and social media platforms.
tgt_text: Abanto basirete nnabo barabwatigwe goetera ekeombe ekebariri (Red Cross) amo nabariki amangana na komanyia abanto amang'ana.

src_text: Stagnant water breeds mosquitoes. Use bed nets and report mosquito infestations to health authorities.
tgt_text: Chiumbu nigo chikoiborerana ase amache atereime. Tumia chineti chiebitanda korara na manyia abanyagitari igoro yokoromwa nechiumbu na buna abanto barwarete.

src_text: Communities should invest in boreholes and rainwater harvesting to ensure water access during droughts.
tgt_text: Nere buya ebinyoro kobeka chinguri chiabo ase okorema ebisima ebinene bia abanto abange nomoroberion bwogotacha amache erio koba namache aisaine chingaki chieguragura.

src_text: Kenya's policy framework ensures coordinated disaster management. Understand your rights and government obligations.
tgt_text: Amachiko aKenya igoro yobokoreri ekero kia omobasekano nkoenekia are ng'a okobeaterana nekomoti yemebasekano. Manya aboronge bwao neki eserikari ebwenerete kogokorera.

src_text: The national helpline 1195 is available at all times to provide immediate assistance to survivors of sexual and gender-based violence.
tgt_text: Enamba yesimi yogokonya 1195 inao ere ase chingaki chionsi ase ogokonya bari batarareirwe, gotibonwa gose komocherwa nchera ende yonsi koreng'ana na eki ore.

src_text: Intimate partner violence often escalates gradually. Early recognition and training for frontline professionals support prevention and safe referrals.
tgt_text: Eminano gose ogokurarana gati yomosacha nomokungu oye mara aanga nigo gokogenderera kogesekana na koba boke ng'orang'ora. Mbuya komanya ayio bwango na kwegeria abakoreri baria bare motwe gokonya ase okobaikera na kobakonya ebirengererio na kobaraa gochia nyagitari ase kobwenigwa.

src_text: Personal safety plans help individuals prepare for dangerous situations by identifying safe locations and strategies for protection.
tgt_text: Omoroberio oo aye omonyene kwerenda ngokonya ore kwebanga chingaki chiokong'u ase okomanya boronge ase ogotamera gochia na buna okwerenda.

src_text: Community support networks assist survivors by providing safe spaces, trained volunteers, empowerment programs, and coordinated referrals while prioritizing safety and confidentiality.
tgt_text: Ebokundi biogosira ase ebinyoro nigo bigokonya baria bakoreirwe bobe ase enchera yokobaa aase bakobera atari namochando onde bwonsi goetera abakonyi babo bokwerwa begeirie buya, kobasira goetera ebinto bike bike bikobakonya, na kobwaterana gochia ase baranyare konyora obokonyi ao ao, oborendi bwaigoro nobobisi bwabo.

src_text: Workplace policies and training prevent sexual harassment by establishing clear definitions, reporting channels, investigations, and support services based on national legal frameworks.
tgt_text: Koba namachiko ase abanto bagokora emeremo na kobaegeria igor yoboronge bwa mwanyabanto ngokonya ere gokorerwa bobe kebwanchani egekogera kera omokori emeremo amanyete buya nga ogokora eke gose keria aya naria naro aramonyore, chinchera omonto akomanyeria abane igoro yayio, obotuki, amo nemeroberio yokomosira korengna nerichiko riense.

src_text: Child protection systems must prevent sexual abuse and exploitation and provide full support for affected children.
tgt_text: Nebwenerete nga ebitengo bionsi bire bikorenda abana gtanga na abana gotibonwa na bosomba bonde bwonsi goetera okobaa ogokonya gwa kera engencho.

src_text: Healthcare workers require specialized training in trauma-informed care, evidence collection, mandatory reporting, and coordinated referrals for survivors.
tgt_text: Abakori emeremo bobochenu mbaganeirie amaorokererio abeene ase ogokonya barwaire babo komanya emechando nagekong'ia koyerwania, kobeka amo obosaiti , kobeka eripoti as ebitabu, na na okobwatera kobatoma gochia baranyore obokonyi bwa beene.

src_text: Safe houses and shelters offer secure temporary accommodation for survivors and their children.
tgt_text: Aase agiya neyomba yokomenya nensemo eyemo yoborendi ase baria bakoreirwe bobe nabana babo.

src_text: Digital spaces can expose individuals to online abuse. Laws criminalize cyberviolence and support services help survivors secure devices, report incidents, and remove harmful content.
tgt_text: Goetera obokonyi bwedichitari nkonyarekana ere gosioria baria bagokorera bobe abande goetera eintaneti. Amachiko nkorenda are abanto tobakorerwa bobe goetera eintaneti na kobakonya korenda chisimi nechikombiuta chiabo neintaneti korwa ebibago, korwa eripoti yokogoserwa, na gotinyia amangana aria akogechia.

src_text: Engaging men and boys in prevention programs promotes healthy relationships and challenges harmful gender norms.
tgt_text: Renta abasacha nabura amo ase emeroberio yogosegeta oboamate obuya ase abanto na orokereria buna ogotareng'anana kwa banto ase engencho yebimira ere bobe.

src_text: Legal aid services ensure survivors access justice through free or subsidized representation.
tgt_text: Ogokonya abanto kemachiko nigo korengete korora nga goikera ekeene goeera gokonywa bosa otari korwa kende gose ogoaka pesa inke igo omogambi bwebina gokogambera kotini.

src_text: Educational institutions must implement prevention programs that address harassment, assault, and exploitation in learning environments.
tgt_text: Chisukuru razima chiikeranie emeroberio gotanga gokorerwa bobe kobasuguma gose kobagechi, kobarwania ngose komiga oboronge bwabo ase engencho bare abagongeru ase chisukuru.

src_text: Economic abuse limits financial independence. Financial institutions should recognize warning signs and support affected customers.
tgt_text: Obosaria bwobogoko nigo bokomiga okwenyara nogwetenenera gwechibesa. Ebiombe baria bionsi bigokora nechibesa nere buya asebire komanya bwango emechando ere motwe na buna baranyare gokonya baria bakogachera chibesa chiabo.

src_text: Human trafficking for sexual exploitation is a serious crime. National laws provide strong penalties and survivor protections.
tgt_text: Enchera yokobetereria gose koira abanto ase egete ase engencho yokobaonia ase ebiasara biobwanchani konyora chibesa okomocha okobe mono. Amachiko yense nkorwa are egesusuro ekerito na gokonya baria bakoreirwe bobe.

src_text: Risk assessment tools help identify individuals at high risk of experiencing or perpetrating violence to enable targeted interventions.
tgt_text: Amasakara abwate amaborio na buna abanto bakoiraneria ebigokonya korora na komanya buna abanto baria bare ase ekonyarekana gokorerwa bobe gose kogenderera gokorerwa bobe erio gokonya kobeka emeroberio yogotanga ebwenerete.

src_text: Survivor-centered approaches uphold safety, dignity, and autonomy in all decisions about reporting and service use.
tgt_text: Emeroberio yokobakonya baria bakoreirwe bobe nigo ekoimokereria igoro oborendi, amasikani, obobisi, nobosibore bwomonto korwa ebirengerio biaye neko aganeti gokorerwa.

src_text: Emergency settings heighten gender-based violence risks and require specialized prevention and response planning.
tgt_text: Chingaki chiemebasekano gose obokongu nigo chikogesa ribaga abanto gokorerwa bobe ekiagera eki bare naya ekero abeire neganeirie chinchera chigotanga abanto gokorerwa bobe chaiabeene na emeroberio buna baranyare gokonywa.

src_text: Reliable data systems track violence trends and service use to inform evidence-based policies and programs.
tgt_text: Amangana aria arikire amaikeranu buna chiripoti chiabasikari, chianyagitari na NGOs chikworokia buna abanto bagokorerwa bobe erio gokonya korosia amachiko nemeroberio yokobakonya.

src_text: Strategic communication campaigns promote non-violent norms and responsible media coverage of gender-based violence.
tgt_text: Omoroberio bwoboamo obangire buya komanyia na gosomia abanto korengete gosegeta abanto goonchoreria na kwanga gokorera abanto bande bobe na korwa eripoti igoro ya baria bakoreirwe bobe otarikonyorwa, amo noboriki na komanyia abanto amang'ana goetera chiredio na amagaseti ase enchewra etari koeneria gokwanrera obobe bwogokorera aband bobe.

src_text: Persons with disabilities face higher risks of violence. Services must meet accessibility needs and provide inclusive support.
tgt_text: Abanto abaremaru nigo bagokorerwa bobe kobua abanto bande. Ogokonywa kobarengete goika goikeranie buna bagoikerwa nokogania kwabo ase bonsi.

src_text: Correctional facilities must prevent sexual violence and respond effectively to any incidents.
tgt_text: Chichera goika chitange ogokorerwa bobe ekiagera eki oro na korwa egusuro korengana nokomocha kwabamochi.

src_text: Technology-facilitated abuse requires digital security training and documentation skills for affected individuals.
tgt_text: Ogokorerwa bobe goetra eintaneti neganetie oborendi bwegedichitari goetera ogosomia nenchera engiya yokorika na kogacha amang'ana ase bari bakoreire bobe.

src_text: Community-based prevention programs mobilize local leaders and groups to create safer environments.
tgt_text: Oborendi goetera emeroberio yebinyoro goetra okoreta abarai nebiombe amo korora nga abanto bonsi mbuya bare kera ase bare.

src_text: Research strengthens program design and policy by generating evidence on effective prevention and response strategies.
tgt_text: Amasomo okorigia chisemi chinyia, kobanga emeroberio na korosia amachiko goetera obomanyi obwo koba nechinguru gotanga gokorerwa bobe.

src_text: Women in politics face violence aimed at limiting participation. Electoral laws protect candidates and voters from gender-based harm.
tgt_text: Obakungu bagokora siasa nigo bagokorerwa bobe korengete gokeania esiasa yabo gochia ase abasqacha. Amachiko obochori nkorenda are abarigia chikura nabaaki chikura korwa gokorerwa bobe ekiagera eki bare.

src_text: Healthcare facilities must screen for violence and provide safe and comprehensive responses for survivors.
tgt_text: Ase abanto bakobwenerigwa goikbapime ekerengo omonto okoreire bobe na korwa obobwenia boisaine naende obuya.

src_text: Public transport systems must address harassment through staff training and appropriate response measures.
tgt_text: Abarai bechirori chikobogori abanto goika chitange ebikoru biokogosereria goetera ogosomia bakori emeremo babo na korwa egesusuro ase abamochi.

src_text: Women in agriculture face distinct risks. Cooperatives should adopt prevention policies and reporting options.
tgt_text: Abakungu bagokora emeremo ase oboremi nigo bare ase okonyorwa nemechando yabeene. Ebiombe bioboremi nere buya bitabe amachiko yogotanga nenchera yokorwa chiripoti.

src_text: High-density informal settlements require community-led safety efforts to reduce violence.
tgt_text: Abanto bamenyete chirandi mabaganetie okobwaterana newbinyoro erio gokeania chiburaburu.

src_text: Religious institutions influence community norms. Clergy training and counseling support safe and equitable environments.
tgt_text: Chidini ngosegeta chire buna ebinyoro bikorosia amachiko ekemira. Gosomia barai bechidini nigo egokonya gosegeta ababwatai babo korenda amasingira.

src_text: Sports programs must prevent harassment, abuse, and hazing through clear boundaries and reporting procedures.
tgt_text: Emeroberio yechigori goika ekonye gotanga ebikoru bikogosereri agose bikogechi, gose bikorasimisa omonto gosoa na chinchera chiokoripoti ayio.

src_text: Fishing industry environments pose risks of exploitation. Safety improvements at docks support worker protection.
tgt_text: Emeremo yoborubi chinswe yaretire obwoba bwokorerwa bobe na koriananigwa. Gokongia oborendi aaria ase chinswe chigoikerigwa korwa obwato ngosira ere oborendi bwabokori emeremo.

src_text: Mining areas require strict policies and safety measures to prevent harassment and exploitation.
tgt_text: Okorema amadini nigo koganetie amachiko amaikeranu noborendi gotanga okorera abande bobe, kogechi gose gochaya nakobarianania .

src_text: Market environments must establish reporting systems and committees to prevent harassment and extortion.
tgt_text: Chichiro goika chibe nemeroberio egokonya abanyabiasara korwa okwemurangania kwabo gotanga gokorerwa bobe, kiogechigwa, kogosererigwa gose kobetererigwa gkorwa chibesa.

src_text: Residential facilities for persons with disabilities require strong safeguards and accessible education on rights and reporting.
tgt_text: Aase abanto bamenyete na mono baria bare noborema chinchera chiokobarenda chingiya nchiganeirie na kobakonya goikera chisemi chioboronge na buna baranyare goteba ekero bakoreirwe bobe.

src_text: Government workplaces must maintain zero tolerance for harassment through training, accountability, and independent reporting systems.
tgt_text: Aaria chiofisi chieserikari ase abanto bagokorera emeremo goika chitange ogokorerwa bobe, kobabetereria gose kobagosereria oetera okobasomia, obotenereri, nechinchera chiokorwa okwemurangania kwabo.

src_text: Children face online risks. Parents should monitor use, apply controls, and teach safe behavior.
tgt_text: Abana mbare ase hatari goetera eintaneti. Abaibori goika bamongere buna abana babo bagotumia eintaneti, batabge na komanyia abana babo chinchera chingiya chibaretere emechando.

src_text: Child trafficking remains a major threat. Communities should report suspicious activity to authorities.
tgt_text: Ogosoi abana ase ebinto bitancheiri, kobatamia gose kobabisa erio kobatumia ase chinchera chitabwenereti neringa rinene riokogosia. Ebinyoro goika birwe amang'ana igiro yebinto bare nechitangutangu ase abagambi gose abasikari.

src_text: Schools must implement protection policies, anti-bullying systems, and counseling services to safeguard learners.
tgt_text: Chisukuru goika chiikerania amachiko oborendi, gokorera abana abande bobe, na korwa obosemia erio korenda abana buya.

src_text: Foster caregivers must be vetted to ensure safe environments for vulnerable children.
tgt_text: Abaibori abarendi babana barigererigwa buya bataraegwa abana korenda erio korenda nga abana baria abake batanyare kwerenda.

src_text: Children experiencing trauma need psychological support available through free counseling services.
tgt_text: Abana bare ase ogochandeka bwebirengererio mbagabeti ogokonywa kobakonya gokinania omochando oyio bosa goetera chinkwana nomonyagitari konyora chinguru chiogokinana nebirengererio.

src_text: Street-connected children require shelters, education, and reintegration programs for safety and development.
tgt_text: Abana baria banarete obogima bwokobera ebisona ase chitaoni mbaganetie ase bakorara, chisemi, nemeroberio yokobairania chinka chiabo ase oborendi namagenderero.

src_text: Child labor is illegal. Report hazardous child work to the Labour Department or call 0800220444.
tgt_text: Obosomba bwabana mamincha yerichiko. Karwe eripoti igoro yabana bare ase emeremo eranyare kobaretera emechando gochia chiofisi chitenererete obokori emeremo gose goaka esimi 0800220444.

src_text: Children involved in legal processes should receive specialized legal aid through the Office of the Director of Public Prosecutions.
tgt_text: Abana abwo bare ase okoariganigwa gotamigwa mamincha yerichiko neganeirie konyora obokonyi mwachiko bosa goetera ofisi yomoteneneri bwobosoi ebina (ODPP).

src_text: Children should learn to protect personal information online and report suspicious interactions to trusted adults.
tgt_text: Nere buya abana kwegera buna baranyare korenda amangana abo arikire are ase eintaneti na komanyia oyo begenete igoro yechitang'utang'u.

src_text: Domestic violence harms children. Report incidents to local authorities or child helplines.
tgt_text: Chiburaburu chiekenyomba nigo chikoumisa gose gosaria abana. Karwe amangana igoro yaya gochia abagambi gose chiofosi chieserikari chirendete abana.

src_text: Government and NGOs support orphaned children with essential services. Adoption and foster care follow legal guidelines.
tgt_text: Eserikari na NGOs ngokonya chire abana chitankana ase okobakonya ase chinchera ao ao chiengencho. Buna okogora abana ase enchera yamachiko gochia abaibiri bakabere na kobabwatia kemachiko komanya ng'a mbuya barendete abana abwo.

src_text: Every child has rights to education, healthcare, and protection. Communities must report violations.
tgt_text: Kera omwana nare noboronge bwokonyora chisemi, obobwenia, na oborendi. Abanto goika barwe eripoti igoro yotaikeranigwa kwayio.

src_text: Bullying leads to depression and school dropouts. Schools must enforce strict anti-bullying policies and provide counseling for affected children.
tgt_text: Ogokorera abande bobe nigo gokoreta ogochandeka kwebirengererio, ogoichania goika gotiga amasomo. Chisukuru nere buya kobeka amachiko amakong'u gotanga ogokorera abande bobe na korwa obosemia ase abana baria bakoreirwe bobe.

src_text: In disasters (floods, fires), children are most vulnerable. Ensure they are evacuated safely and receive psychosocial support.
tgt_text: Ekero kiemebasekano buna (etoigo, nopgwateka kwemerero), abana nabwo bagochandeka mono ekiagera batari naguru chigokonya. Rora ng'a batammigwe gose korusigwa aroro buya na bae ogokonywa kwebirengererio goetra okobakwanera.

src_text: Children with disabilities face higher risks of abuse. Ensure inclusive education and accessible reporting mechanisms for their protection.
tgt_text: Abana bare noborema nigo ere raisi ase bare gokorerwa bobe. Rora nga abana bonsi ba kera engencho banyorire chisemi na buna baranyare komanyia igoro yogokorerwa bobe ase oborendi bwabo.

src_text: Local communities should establish child protection committees to monitor and report abuse cases, working closely with government agencies.
tgt_text: Nere buya ebinyoro koba nechikomiti igoro yoborendi bwa abana chikomongera na koripoti buna abana kogorerwa bobe, gokora emeremo yabo ase ase okobwaterana nebiombe bieserikari.

src_text: The Kenya Police have specialized desks to handle child-related cases with sensitivity and confidentiality. Report cases at any police station.
tgt_text: Chipori stesheni nchire negetengo kiabeen kegosugurikia buna abana bakomecherwa buna ogoakwa, ogotibongwa, obosomba, okoiba gose gokengania abana ase enchera chiobosani nabana na erendete obobisi bwabana. Karwe eripoti ase porisi stesheni ende yonsi.

src_text: Neglect harms a child's development. Parents and guardians must provide basic needs, love, and security to prevent long-term trauma.
tgt_text: Ogotarenda gose koa omwana ebinto atagete nigo ekogocha ogokina na okogenderera kwomwana. Abaibori nabarendi babana goika bae abana babo ebi bakonyara, buna obwanchani, noborendi gotanga mechando yebirengererio nogochandeka ase engaki entambe.

src_text: Refugee children are vulnerable to abuse and trafficking. Humanitarian agencies provide safe shelters and education in camps.
tgt_text: Abana ba baria batamete chisegi korwa sobo igo ere raisi ase bare gokorerwa bobe gokenganigwa gose koibwa. Ebiombe bikorwanerera oboronge bwekemwanyabanto bieserikari nkorwa bire obomenyo obuya nechisemi aaria ase chikambi.

src_text: Some communities still practice harmful traditions involving children. Report such cases to authorities immediately.
tgt_text: Abanto bande mbagenderete gokora ebienyechi buna ogekeba abanyaroka ebio bire mamincha noboronge bwa abana. Karwe eripoti yamang'ana ayio gochia ase abambi otari konyorwa.

src_text: Positive parenting reduces abuse risks. Attend government-sponsored parenting programs to learn child protection strategies.
tgt_text: Oboreri obuya nigo bogokeania abana gokorerwa bobe. Soa gose kabe oyomo ase omoroberio bweserikari gosomigwa chinchera buna oranyare korenda abana.

src_text: Children involved in legal matters should go through specialized courts to ensure fair and trauma-sensitive proceedings.
tgt_text: Ebina birengete abana goika ebina biabo bigamberwe ase chikoti chiabeene korora ng'a biagendiigwe buya birendete gotatubania obongo naende korwa obobe bwabete.

src_text: Underage drug use leads to crime and health issues. Schools and parents should educate children on substance abuse dangers.
tgt_text: Abana abake konywa amarwa nigo gokogesa obosaria nemechando ya afia. Nere buya chisukuru nabaibori basomie abana igoro yemachando yokonywa amarwa.

src_text: Dial 116 (Child Helpline) or 999 (Emergency) to report child abuse, neglect, or exploitation for immediate assistance.
tgt_text: Aka esimi 116 (Obokonyi ase Abana) gose 999 (Emebasekano) komnyia igoro yogokorerwa bobe kwomwana, ogoserigwa gose okwangwa, gose koba ase obosomba erio onyore ogokonya kegima.

src_text: Children in areas like Northern Kenya face abduction and recruitment into armed groups. Security agencies must prioritize their safety.
tgt_text: Abana bare chinsemo chiria buna Kenya ya Irianyi nigo ere raisi ase bare koibwa na gosoigwa ase ebiombe biobokebago. Ebiombe bieserikari goika birwe birigerie ayio ase okobarenda.

src_text: Children's identities can be stolen for fraud. Parents should safeguard birth certificates and monitor credit reports.
tgt_text: nabo ekonyarekana nga ebiband biabana bibwe gokorera obongainereria. Abaibori brende buya chisatificate chiokoiborwa chia abana babo no komongera buna chibesa chigosao chisimi chiabo.

src_text: Victims of sexual abuse need medical, legal, and psychological support. Specialized centers offer free services nationwide.
tgt_text: Baria bakoreirwe bobe gose gotibongwa nere buya konyora obokonyi bwobobwenia, kemachiko, anakebirengererio. Chisenta chiegeirie gokora emeremo eyio nkorwa chire obokonyi bwa bosa Kenya engima.

src_text: Many children drown in open water sources. Parents should supervise kids near pools, rivers, and wells.
tgt_text: Abana abange nigo bkogwa nagokwera ime yechinsemo chiamache. Abaibiri goika barande abana babio ekero bare ange nase aria agoakerwa ontimbu, chindoche, amo nechinsoko.

src_text: Churches and mosques must vet staff and implement policies to prevent child abuse within their facilities.
tgt_text: Chikanisa nemesikiti goika bakongori abakori emeremo babo na goikerania amachiko agotanga gokorera abana bobe imse yechinyomba chiikanisa gose emesikiti.

src_text: Media should avoid exposing children to harmful content and respect their privacy when reporting on abuse cases.
tgt_text: Abariki na baria bagotangasa amang'ana goika barende gotanga nga amangana agosaria abana ase ogotatora amarieta abo nase barwete ekero bakomanyia amangan buna abana bagokorerwa bobe.

src_text: Criminal gangs exploit children for begging. Report such cases to the police for rescue and rehabilitation.
tgt_text: Ebibago nigo bigotumia ribaga riabana gotenyara ase ogosaberera. Manyia abasikari kobakonya na kobarongei.

src_text: Ensure school vans are properly licensed and drivers vetted to prevent accidents and kidnappings.
tgt_text: Rora nga chirori chisukuru nchuibwate chirensesi buya nomotereba buya achoretwe korenga gotanga emebasekano na koibwa kwa abana.

src_text: Extremist groups target vulnerable children. Communities should report suspicious recruitment activities.
tgt_text: Ebiobago biria bigosaria amongo abanto na kobaira obokebago bwokotuta chipomu nigo nigo birengete abana baria batari kwenyara gose korwa emchie emetaka . Abanto gioka barwe eripoti igoro yebinto bare nechitang'utang'u nabirobio gose okorikwa gosoa obokebago obwo.

src_text: Teach children fire safety measures and ensure homes have working smoke detectors to prevent tragedies.
tgt_text: Somia abana chinhera chiokwerenda nomorero na rora ng'a chinka chibwate egento keria gekomanya ekero erioki rireo erio gokonya gotanga emerero gwateka.

src_text: Online games can expose children to predators. Parents should monitor gaming interactions and set time limits.
tgt_text: Chigosori chieintaneti nigo chigosuguma abana ang'e gochia ase ebibago biabo. Abaibori goika bamongere chingaki abana bakorrigereria chigosori na ase chinsa gete.

src_text: Families should include children in disaster drills and ensure they know emergency contacts.
tgt_text: Chifamiri goika chisangie abana babo amo koroberia buna baranyare gotange omorero tibwateka sobo na ekero bwatekire ase bagotamera gochia nechinamba chiesimi barangerie konyora ogokonya.

src_text: Businesses must avoid employing children and support initiatives for their education instead.
tgt_text: Abanyabiasara goika barende tibarika abana buna abkori emeremo yabo korende basire emeroberio yogokonya ng'a bachire esukuru gosoma.

src_text: Sports academies must have policies against physical and sexual abuse of young athletes.
tgt_text: Aaria ase abanto bagosomera gokora chogosori goika babe namachiko agotanga gokorerwa bobe ekiagera eki ore gose ogotabatabwa ase abanyagosori abasae.

src_text: Event organizers should provide child-safe spaces and lost-child protocols during large gatherings.
tgt_text: Baria bakoroberria emeyega nere buya kobekaase abana basirete bakobekwa negento abaibiri basireriigwe nabana babo babwenerete gokora ekero kiesangerekano emenene.

src_text: Tourist hotspots sometimes exploit children for labor or sex. Report such cases to the Tourism Regulatory Authority.
tgt_text: Aase abanto bakorwa isiko (abatari) bagotarera chingaki chinyinge nigo akoba aase abana bagokorigwa egasi gose gotibongi. Karwe eripoti gochia baria batenenerete obotari.

src_text: Kenya's laws are evolving to better protect children's rights. Stay informed on legal changes affecting child welfare.
tgt_text: machiko a Kenya akongiigwe erio korenda abana baria batari konyara kwerenda gose korwa emechie emetaka erio korenda oboronge bwa abana. Kabe gokomanyigwa igoro yamaonchorerio arengete ebiombe biabana.

src_text: Neighbors, teachers, and relatives must speak up against child abuse to create safer environments for children.
tgt_text: Abaamate,abarimu, na abairi goika bakwenere ringana igoro yabana gokorerwa bobe erio korora ng'a abana tibari ase hatari yogokorerwa bobe.

src_text: Livestock theft remains a challenge in pastoralist regions. Communities should form watch programs, brand animals, and report suspicious activities.
tgt_text: Oboibi bwechiombe nabo botigarete koba omochando aaria chinsemo chiobotugi. Nere buya ebinyoro koba nemeroberio yobomongeri, basambererie chiombe chiabo chinamba, na korwa eripoti igoro yamangana bare nechitangutangu naro.

src_text: Water scarcity during droughts causes losses. Farmers should adopt water harvesting methods such as dams, pans, and subsurface storage.
tgt_text: Ogokeana kwamache chingaki chieguragura nigo ekorenta asara Nere buya abaremi kwegera gotacha na kogacha amache ase okorema chingoro, kogora ebibuyu ebinene, koagacha chitangi chia'mahe inse yeriraba.

src_text: Biosecurity prevents disease outbreaks. Disinfect footbaths, quarantine new animals, control wildlife access, and report sick animals promptly. Proper carcass disposal is essential.
tgt_text: Gotanga okoererania etugo korwa ensemo eyemo gochia eyende nigo egotana okwambokerana kwamarwaire yetugo nabanto. Beta chiombe esindani yoborwaire bwomonwa namagoro, chiombe chikorwaa gochia aria chichanche, renda chingiti chiorosana tichiika ange, na karwe eripoti ioro yetugo erwarete otrikonyorwa. Tindeka etugo eri yakure inse kabisa.

src_text: The Kenya Livestock Identification and Traceability System assigns herd numbers and ear tags to support theft prevention and disease control.
tgt_text: Omoreoberio o'Kenya komanya etugo, na komanya ase yarwete ngosambereria ore chiombe chinamba gose gochikera chinamba ase amato buna enchera yogotanga oboibi.

src_text: Wildlife predation causes losses. Farmers should construct predator-proof enclosures and use guard animals. Compensation is available for verified cases.
tgt_text: Ogoitwa gwetugo nechingiti chiorosana buna endagera yabo nigo gokoreta asara ase omoremi. Nere buya abaremi koagacha gose kogitera etugo yabo buya gotanga chingiti chiorosana goikera etugo yabo na koyeita bua endagera yabo. Ogoakanwa ase baria etugo yabo yaitetwe nechingiti chiorosana nereo ase baria bagitere etugo yabo buya.

src_text: Index-based livestock insurance protects pastoralists from drought losses using satellite data triggers.
tgt_text: Ensuarence erendete abaremi bobotugi nereo ekero rioka yamanyakinire nga omobaso omonene gose etoigo gose ogwateka kwendwari etare konyarekana ekorenda abatugi gotera ebimoreki bieintenet igoro aa ase rire bokorenga ekerengo omochando ore gokonys chiinsuarence komanya nechibesa irenga bagoakana omoremi.

src_text: Unauthorized livestock movement spreads disease. Farmers should demand permits and follow quarantine notices.
tgt_text: Okoererania gwetugo gotancheirie nigo kogotaria amarwaire. Nere buya abaremi basabe rirube rikobanchera goetia etugo korwa aa gochia aari na kobwatia amachiko ogochancha chitugo chiabo.

src_text: Proper slaughter methods protect meat safety. Only use licensed slaughterhouses or follow public health guidelines for home slaughter.
tgt_text: Obonyenyi etugo obuya na gacha enyama buya protect. Tumia ebichinchio biria biancheire gose bwatia amachiko yobochenu ekero okonyenya etugo yao nka.

src_text: Certain plants poison livestock. Farmers should remove toxic plants and provide alternative fodder during drought. Veterinary analysis supports diagnosis.
tgt_text: Ekero etugo yarire emete gete nigo ekoba esumu mebere yabo. Nere buya abaremi batogore emete buna eyio yonsi na koa chitugo chiabo obonyansi obuya chinaki chiguragura. Ogopima etugo yao nomonyagitari bwetugo nabio bikoenekia ayio.

src_text: Drought requires special management. Provide minerals, reduce herd size early, and conserve water.
tgt_text: Eguragura nego eganitie emeroberio emeikernu korenda amache, gosiarera ebimeri amache, na koa etugo amache okonywa. Karwe amache echichuba, keania obonge bwetugo yao genkioy, na gacha amache.

src_text: Proper feed storage prevents aflatoxin contamination. Keep grains dry, mold-free, and securely stored.
tgt_text: Kogacha endagrera buya nigo egokonya ogotabosa kwendagera.

src_text: Early reporting prevents outbreaks. Contact veterinary officers or the Toll-Free Animal Disease Hotline 0800721313.
tgt_text: Korwa eripoti bwango igoro yamarwaire gochia ase abanyagitari nigo egotanga oborwaire kwambokerana/koranda. Manyia omonyagitari bwetugo rangeria esimi eye yamorero 0800721313 otari goakana kende.

src_text: Climate change increases animal risks. Provide shade, drainage, windbreaks, and use early warning systems.
tgt_text: Ogoonchoreria kwerire nigo gokogesa emechando ase atugo. Beka etugo yao inse yekiriri, emetaro yogosokia amache amachafu, chimbago gotanga embeo, na komanya bwango igoro yogoonchoreria kwerire bwebage.

src_text: Milk safety requires hygiene. Wash udders, use clean containers, cool milk, and sell only to licensed processors.
tgt_text: Okogacha amere buya neganetie obochenu. Sibia enyeri nechimbere buya, beka amabere ase egento ekerabu, kendia amabere, na yaoneri bari bawete amarube yokobanchera koonia amabere boke.

src_text: Pastoralist migrations need planning. Obtain permits, choose safe routes, and avoid conflict areas.
tgt_text: Okonganya korwa aa gochia aaria kwa abatugi nkoganetie emeroberio emiya. Nyora ogwancherwa gwokong'anya netugo yao, etera ase atari nemechando, kabe are korwa chingongo chiria chire neminano.

src_text: Accurate records improve management. Track births, deaths, treatments, and vaccinations.
tgt_text: Amariko abwate maeleso yoboremi bwetugo yao nigo akogokonya ase emeroberio yao. Bwatia komanya chitariki chia kera etugo ekero yabiaretwe, ogokwa, buna kwarure obobwenia, na gochichancha.

src_text: Beehive theft is rising. Secure apiaries, mark hives, and report suspicious buyers.
tgt_text: Oboibi bwemetana yechinchoke mbogendererete kogeseka. Renda buya emetana, yebeka chinamba, na manyia igoro yabagori bakengeka.

src_text: Industrial pollutants harm animals. Report dumping, fence off contaminated sites, and test water.
tgt_text: Obochafu bokorwa ase chifakitori nigo bokorentera etugo obokongu. Karwe eripoti igoro gotuguta obochafu bwabo ase enchera etari engiya, gita aase eubochafu bogotugutwa, na pima amche komanya gose nabwate ebinyinyi.

src_text: Floods kill animals and spread disease. Move herds to higher ground and disinfect pens after floods.
tgt_text: Omogoko omonene nigo ogoita etugo na okoranda kwendwarim yetugo. Siarera obweri eriogo motwe yemegoko.

src_text: Community policing reduces livestock theft. Share intelligence and support police investigations.
tgt_text: Oborendi bwebinyoro nogo bogokeania oboibi bwetugo. Karwe amanagana obotuki na bwatisia porisi kobeka oborendi.

src_text: Proper manure handling prevents disease. Compost before use and store away from water sources.
tgt_text: Kogacha na gotumia bobe obwoyo buya nigo kogokeania amarwaire. Karwe ribaga risaine ase eubo koguna na goonchoreria koba obwoyo omanye kobotumia na bobeke are korwa ase amache.

src_text: Snakes bite animals in dry seasons. Clear bushes and seek immediate treatment for bites.
tgt_text: Chingiti chingenda nse nkorasa chire etugo aaria chingongo chinyomo. Rabia orsana na rigia obowenia bwa bwango ase etugo yao rasirwe neng'iti engenda nse.

src_text: Auction yards attract criminals. Use licensed yards, verify buyers, and maintain registers.
tgt_text: Ase ebinto bigoakerwa omonada nigo akongusa ebibago. Akera omonada aase aitabire neserikari, rigereria buya abagori baino, na gacha buya amariko buna ogoaka omonada ebinto ebio.

src_text: Large birds prey on young livestock. Use scare devices and provide sheltered pens.
tgt_text: Ebibaki na makotu nigo akira ebichichu buna endagera yabo. Gitera etugoyao buya na rosia ebinto binga buna omonto obogoretie enyimbo gochia igoro na koyeka aroro kogosa ebinto ebio bitgete koira etugo.

src_text: Disaster preparedness reduces losses. Identify evacuation routes and store emergency supplies.
tgt_text: Kweroberia buya nyuma yemechando nigo ogotanga asara. Orokia chinchera chiokominchoreria ekero kiemebasekano na gacha endagera orarie ekero kiemebasekano.

src_text: Water points attract thieves. Water animals by day and patrol high-risk areas.
tgt_text: Ase amache akobucherwa nigo akongusa ebibago. Ira chiombe kere mobaso konywa amache animals no mokera buya aase okagerete abaibi barabaise korwera.

src_text: Animal noise disturbs communities. Proper housing reduces noise and prevents complaints.
tgt_text: Okwana gwechiombe nigo gokogechia abanto. Koagacha obweri obuya nigo bogotanga eriogi riokwana na igo gotanga abanto kwemurangania.

src_text: Stray animals destroy property. Maintain secure fencing and report damage promptly.
tgt_text: Etugo yabagoire nigo egosari ebimeri biabanto. Gitera buya etugo yao na manyia abanyene ekero etugo yao yasaririe ebinto bia bande.

src_text: Dry season fires threaten grazing areas. Create firebreaks and report arson incidents.
tgt_text: Omorero chingaki chieguragura nigo okorenta obokongu ase oborisia bwetugo. Onye omogondo bwendagera gose rinani ore omonene, yobarore gati gati na koyatiga atri namete gose obonyansi gotanga omorere gotamboka gochia asande na manyia abarai onye nomonto bwogetie obomorero eyio makusudi.

src_text: Proper breeding management prevents injuries. Use healthy stock, maintain hygiene, and record breeding dates.
tgt_text: Renda korora nga ekero etugo yao ekobwata embego yakorirwe ase enchera engiya etarikoumisa etugo eria ekobwata embego. Tumia eeri ebwate afia engiya , renda obochenu, na rika inse chitariki kwaete etugo yao embego.

src_text: Equipment theft affects productivity. Secure tools and machinery and report theft immediately.
tgt_text: Oboibi bwebinto bioboremi buna chitinga chiokorem nebinde nigo bikoirania magega gose gokei rigesa. Gacha buya ebinto biao biogokora oboremi buya na manyia abagambi igoro yoboibi biebinto biao bioboremi bwngo.

src_text: Lightning kills grazing animals. Install lightning rods and avoid tying animals to isolated trees.
tgt_text: Enkoba nigo egoita etugo ere getii korisia. Beka ebinto biria bikobwata enkoba na tiga gosiba etugo ase omote ore oymo.

src_text: Misuse of antibiotics creates resistance. Follow prescriptions and dispose of drugs safely.
tgt_text: Ekero amariogo aria agotanga ebinyinyi komenta omobere ime agotumeka bobe, nigo akoa ebinyinyi chinguru goika eriogo riasinywa gokora egasi yobobwenia buya. Bwatia amereso omonyagitari buya na tuguta amariogo ase enchera engiya buna eyokoyatindeka.

src_text: Plan feed supplies to avoid shortages. Preserve fodder and use drought-resistant varieties.
tgt_text: Rosia na kogacha endagera yetugo yao genkio gotanyorwa nobokongu abwo motwe. Gacha endagera yetugo yao buya na simeka endagera yetugo eria ekoremereria omogaso omonene.

src_text: Poor handling causes stress and injury. Use non-slip floors and proper restraint equipment.
tgt_text: Ekero etugo ekoirwa ase enchera etari engiya nigo ekoba nobwoba, ogochandeka ebirengererio an koumia. Beka etugo aase atari noboterere na yesibe buya.

src_text: Faulty electrical systems harm animals. Inspect wiring and test for stray voltage regularly.
tgt_text: Esitima etbikirie buya nabo are hatari ase etugo. Rora gose chigwaya nchiererete inse na gopima gose nchire nomorero kera engaki erio korenda etugo teakwa nesisitima.

src_text: Steep water edges trap animals. Install gentle slopes and fence dangerous areas.
tgt_text: Koira etugo rooche konya amache aase are egetionko nabo etugo aranyare gotereria na kogwa amache ime ekwe. Rosia buya aase etugo yao ekonywera amache na gita aase are atari ase etugo.

src_text: Research farms need strict security. Use CCTV, controlled access, and patrols.
tgt_text: Aaria ase oboremi bogokorerwa amasomo ogotema ao ao naganetie oborendi obuya. Tumia ebimoreki biria biekamera bikobwata buna abanto bagosoa nagosoka, renda nga tari kera omonto ogosoa aroro, nobomongeri obuya.

src_text: High temperatures reduce productivity. Provide shade, ventilation, and constant water.
tgt_text: Ekero riberera rire igoro mono nigo rigokei amabere ase etugo. Beka ekiriri, karwe ribaga ase embeo rgoetera, na beka amache okonya ase etugo chingaki chionsi.

src_text: Early warning prevents losses. Monitor conditions and share forecasts with herders.
tgt_text: Komanya omochando bwango nigo kogotanga asara. Rigeria buya komanya rire buna rire na sanga nabatugi bamino.

src_text: Be cautious of investment apps advertised during football matches on illegal streams. Many are fronts for data theft or financial fraud
tgt_text: Erende korwa omochieso ogotangaswa ase chisimi kobeka chibesa ase etimi gete ng'a nonyore chibesa goetra esimi chingaki chiegosri yomopira. Abange ba abwo bakorenta chigosori echi nigo barengete koiba amanga iigoro yao bakorere oboibi.

src_text: "DCI is investigating a fake 'youth startup grant' program circulating on TikTok and Instagram. There is no such initiative funded by the Government of Kenya."
tgt_text: Abanyanyimbo mbagendererete gotuka igoro yogochaka ogokonywa ase abasae neserikari ya Kenya goetera TikTok na Instagram. Gento kenga buna ekio tikeiyo korende noborimo bwoka.

src_text: Several Kenyans have reported scam calls claiming to be from international couriers requesting customs clearance payments. Confirm such calls with KRA or the courier directly
tgt_text: Abakenya abange banyorire chisimi korwa ebobagp bikobasaba chibesa gose kobaa amanga igoro yabo korwa abakweroka buna baria bagokora emeremo yobobogoria emesigo korwa chinse chia isiko mbare nomosigo oo abae chibesa chiogoetia omoesigo iyio erio bagokonye. Koranyore esimi yengencho etye manyia office chia chiebango (KRA) gose ekambani eyio bakogotebi.

src_text: "Be cautious of business mentorship programs advertised by influencers that ask for hefty registration fees. Many lack legal registration."
tgt_text: Renda kegima tosoa ase emeroberio yogosomia igoro goetera chisimi nabanto bare nokobua gokong'ina nakobebegena bagosaba chibesa chinyinge gosoera Abange babanto aba tiberigeti neserikari.

src_text: "We urge wananchi to report any person asking for 'expedited NHIF services' in exchange for cash. NHIF does not charge for processing."
tgt_text: Nigo togosaba abanto komanyia abagambi gose abasikari igoro yabanto bagosaba chibesa basuguikie akadi yao ya NHIF ekore egasi. NHIF teri gosaba besa goetia emesigo.

src_text: "Ministry of Housing has not contracted any agents to collect payments for affordable housing units. Application is done through Boma Yangu portal only."
tgt_text: Eminisitiri yobokoreri bwabanto nkoinyoria ere abakorogia egasi nga baria bakorigia gosoa ase okwegera mono igoro yamosomo abo nigo agwancherwa na gosoa bosa. Kana monto onde bwensi oragosabe riaki.

src_text: Red Cross Kenya cautions citizens against donation drives using MPESA till numbers not registered to the organization. Always crosscheck before sending money.
tgt_text: Ekeombe Ekebaririri gia Kenya kiarure ogokurerwa ase abanainchi igoro yemechango goetera MPESA chinamba chia till chitarikiri rasimi na Safaricom ase abwo bagosaba omochango . Tema komanya buya nyuma otatatoma chibesa chiao.

src_text: Public warning: PSC does not conduct interviews on WhatsApp. Any job ad asking for 'application fees' is fake and should be reported
tgt_text: Ogokurera ase bonsi: Enseo yesrikari eria etenenerete emeremo yeserikari (PSC) teri gokria abanto ogotema gwokorigia emeremo goetra Whatsapp. Any job ad asking for 'application fees' is fake and should be reported

src_text: "CBK is aware of mobile apps charging 'CRB clearance' fees upfront. CRB requests are processed through licensed bureaus only."
tgt_text: "Ebengi enene ya Kenya (CBK ) nemanyete ebikoreri biechisimi apps charging 'CRB clearance' fees upfront. Ogosaba gochia baria batenenerete ogosaria kwobogoko (CRB) nigo kogokorwa nabanto bancheire gokora egasi eyio boka"

src_text: EACC has flagged a syndicate offering forged title searches and valuations in Kisumu. Use verified government channels only
tgt_text: Ekeombe keria gekorwania obokengeka (EACC) yarure ogokurerwa igoro yamarube oborimo koa abanto emeremo, gose chinamba chiamaremo chioborimo, na korenga oboremo obwo nga nirenga boisaine aaria Kisumu. Tumia chiofisi chieserikari ekero otagete komanya ayio boronge.

src_text: "DCI confirms arrests of fake NGO representatives claiming to partner with World Food Programme in Northern Kenya. Always verify through official NGO registry."
tgt_text: "Omotuki omonene enekirie okobwatwa kwa abatenereri be'NGO boborimo bakweroka abakobwaterana nekeombe kia Omoroberio Bwendagera Bwense (World Food Programme) aaria Kenya ya Irianyi. Botambe manya boronge korwa egetabu gia NGO."

src_text: Communications Authority warns of cloned betting apps circulating on Telegram. Many steal your phone data and banking information
tgt_text: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenerete okoererania amangana ase embeo kiarure ogokurera igoro yegokoreri gia bahati na sibu kioborimo kerandete ase Telegram. Abange nigo bakoiba amanga ao are ase esimi amo nayenamba yebengi yao.

src_text: KRA reminds taxpayers that agents are not allowed to collect cash payments in person. Use official PayBill numbers and receipts
tgt_text: Ekeombe ekenene giokorusia ebango gia Kenya (KRA) nkoinyoria kere baakani abango nga abaachenti babo tibaganeirie korusia ebango gose koegwa chibesa tbarabwo abanyene. Tumia enamba yabeene ya PayBill na nyora risiti riogoakana.

src_text: "We urge Kenyans to confirm job offers from airlines, especially Emirates and Qatar Airways. Multiple scams promising airport jobs have been flagged.
tgt_text: "Nigo togosaba abakenya komanya buya amatangaso yechigasi korwa ase ebitii bienchindege, mono kobua buna keria Emirates na Qatar. Amatangaso amange yoborimo igoro yemeremo ase ebitii biechindege bwaansire.
