src_text: EACC is investigating individuals posing as ministry auditors soliciting bribes from small schools. All inspections are officially scheduled and documented
tgt_text: Ekeombe keria ekenene gekorwani obopkorekanu (EACC) ngotuka kere abanto gete bagwekora baria bakorigereria amatumisi yechibesa chieserikari na igo gosaba amaaki korwa ase chisukuru chinke. Okorigererigwa bwebitabu nigo gokoba ekero gwatangasirwe.

src_text: "CBK reminds Kenyans that legitimate banks do not conduct promotions via Facebook inboxes. Ignore messages asking for account details to 'activate rewards'."
tgt_text: "Ebengi enene ya Kenya (CBK) nkoinyoria ere abanto ba Kenyan ng'a chibengi boronge tichiri gokinia abakori emeremo babo goetera Facebook. Ombia mang'ana ande onsi akogosaba obae ennamba yao yebengi erio bakobekere ekeegwa gie chibesa."

src_text: "DCI warns against conmen selling fake 'church land' in Kayole and Ruai. Verify ownership documents at the Ministry of Lands before making any payment."
tgt_text: "Omotuki omonene orure ogokurera gochia abangainereria baria bakkonia amaremo echikanisa ataiyo aari kayole na Ruai. Manya buya abanyene oboremo ase ofisi chia amaremo otaraakana besa chinde chionsi."

src_text: NSSF alerts contributors to disregard WhatsApp messages claiming there is a special withdrawal window for those over 40. No such provision exists.
tgt_text: Ekeombe keria ekenene kiabagotu (NSSF) giakureire abanto baye bonsi baombie amanga ande onsi korwa WhatsApp agotebia abanto ng'a baria bonsi baikire emiaka 40 nkonyarekana ere korusia chibesa chiabo. Mang'ana anga buna ayio taiyo.

src_text: Be cautious of investment apps advertised during football matches on illegal streams. Many are fronts for data theft or financial fraud.
tgt_text: Erende korwa amatangaso yokonyora chibesa goetera chitimu chiomopira chikobua chigotangaswa ekero kiemepira egoakwa ase abarimo gagwesoi ime. Abange babwo nigo barengete komanya na koiba amangana yebinto biao bakoibere nonya nechibesa.

src_text: "The Judiciary has received complaints about fake court summons sent via email. Summons are never delivered electronically or through WhatsApp
tgt_text: "EkKoti yanyorire okwemurunganania okonge igoro yokorangerigwa kwa abanto baike kotini ase enchera yoborimo goetera eintaneti. Amangana yokorangerigwa goika kotini tari gotomwa goetera eintaneti gose goetera Whatsapp.

src_text: EACC warns of imposters offering job placements at parastatals for upfront cash. All official job listings are published on PSC and organization websites.
tgt_text: Ekeombe keria ekenene gekorwania obokengeka (EACC) giakureire abakwebeka buna mbare namabaga ase yemeremo ase chikambani chiserikari ase okobaakana besa inke. Emeremo yonsi yeserikari nigo egotangaswa ase ensemo yeserikari tenerete emeremo yeserikari (PSC) na ase eintaneti yechikambani echio.

src_text: "People have been sent 'Safaricom refund claim' links that look like the real site. Safaricom does not issue refunds without an official claim form."
tgt_text: "Abanto batomeirwe amang'ana koiranigwa chibesa ase bare ase egsio ekebe korwa safaricom. 'Ogosabwa oko koirania chibesa nigo kogokorwa ase enchera omonto okonayra kwegena. Safaricom teri gosaba koiranigwa gwechibesa otaichoretie efomu yabeene."

src_text: The Ministry of Transport has received reports of fake NTSA agents collecting bribes along major highways. Report any suspicious activity via 999 or NTSA portal
tgt_text: Emonistiri yobobogoria yanyorire amang'ana igoro yabateneneri boborimo ba (NTSA) bagosaba amaaki ase chinhera chinene. Karwe amangana igoro yamang'ana anga buna ayio are nechitang'utang'u naro goetera enamba yesimi yamorero 999 gose eintaneti ya (NTSA)

src_text: We advise Kenyans not to share photos of their ID, NHIF or voters card on Facebook job groups. These details are being harvested for fraud
tgt_text: Nigo togosemia abanto ba Kenya tibasanga chipicha chibibande chiabana babo, chiria chia nyagitari (NHIF ) gose chikadi chiogoaka chikura ase okorigia emeremo goetera Facebook. Amangana aya yabana bao nigo agotumika gokora obosaria.

src_text: NSSF has suspended several field agents found collecting cash for 'special processing. NSSF does not charge for fast-tracking services
tgt_text: Ekeoombe keria ekenene kiabagotu (NSSF) kiabutire abakori emeremo abange banyoretwe bagosangereria chibesa korwa abagotu erio kobakonya korosia chibesa chiobogotu bwabo. NSSF teri gosaba besa chinde chionsi ekero ekobwatia komanya ayakorengete.

src_text: Several students have lost fees to fake school accounts shared on WhatsApp. Always pay school fees through officially designated bank accounts.
tgt_text: Abana abange basisiririe chibesa chiesukuru fisi goetera chiakaonti chioborimo chibekire WhatsApp. Chingaki chionsi akana chibesa chiesukuru goetera ebengi yesukuru yekeene.

src_text: CBK warns Kenyans against sending money to social media groups promising weekly payouts from investment plans. These are unregulated and illegal.
tgt_text: Ebengi enene ya Kenya (CBK) yakureire abaKenya igoro yogotoma chibesa gochia chigurupu chiembeo bakobangaina konyora obwaita kera ewiki. Ebinto binga buna ebio tibiri bia amachiko igo nebiobong'ainereria.

src_text: Fake insurance brokers have been selling invalid motor covers in bus stations. Confirm your insurer through IRA public registry.
tgt_text: Abaonia bechinsuarensi boborimo babeire bakoonia ebinto bioborimo nonya nime yechirori chibasi. Manya buya ng'a einsuarensi yao nerikire gose neitabire neserikari goetera Insuaren Regulatory Authority (IRA).

src_text: Communications Authority has warned of fake WiFi installers operating in residential estates. Confirm service providers through the CA licensed list
tgt_text: Communications Authority has warned of fake WiFi installers operating in residential estates. Confirm service providers through the CA licensed list

src_text: "We have received multiple reports of individuals faking job placement letters for Qatar and UAE. All foreign employment must go through accredited agencies."
tgt_text: "Twanyorire chiripoti chinyinge chiabanto bagwegokora ng'a mbare namarube yemeremo gochia Qatar na UAE. Emeremo yonsi gochia chinse chia isiko goika aetere ebiombe bimanyekanete buya nabwo bagotebwa nga mbare nemeremo neserikari ya Kenya"

src_text: "Fake humanitarian campaigns using stolen photos have been flagged on Twitter. Always verify fundraisers through trusted platforms like M-Changa or Red Cross Kenya."
tgt_text: "Chibicha chioborimo gotumia chibicha chiabanto bande baibete korigeria chibesa chiangirwe buna okogenda mamincha yerichiko ria twiter. Kera engaki chungusa abakorigia chibesa goetra chinchera chiegenire buna M-Changa gose Omosaraba Omobaririri) Red Cross Kenya."

src_text: Nairobi residents, beware of people who claim to provide business loans within an hour. The government does not have such a cash-in-hand program.
tgt_text: Abamenyi ba Nairobi, kab maiso nabanto bagwekora ng'a nkorwa bare chironi chiebiasara ase engaki yensa eyemo yoka. Eserikari tebwati moroberio onga buna eyio bwechibesa koboko chiokorwa.

src_text: Kenyans are warned to avoid online forex traders promising guaranteed profits. CBK does not license individuals to offer such services.
tgt_text: Abakenya bakureirwe gwetanga koonia chibesa chiechinse ao ao goetera eintaneti abanyabiasara bakongaina abanto nga abaita obonene mboreo. Ebengi enene ya Kenya (CBK) teri korwa erensesi as omonto oyomo gkora agasi eyio.

src_text: DCI cautions the public against forged university admission letters being used to defraud parents. Always verify admission directly with the institution.
tgt_text: Omotuki omonene okureire aanainchi igoro yamarube yogosa eyunifasiti yoborimo agendererete gotimeka kongaina na koibera abaibori. Kera engaki chungusa rirube riogosoa eyunifasiti goetra uyunifasiti enyene.

src_text: "Communications Authority has launched a hotline for reporting impersonation scams involving fake mobile providers. Dial 0800 222 777 to report."
tgt_text: "Ekeombe getenenerete oboererania bwamang'ana giaansire enamba ya morero gokonya koyemanyia gose abasikari igoro yabanto bagwekona nga nkorwa bare obokoreri beintaneti. Aka esimi 0800 222 777 koyemanyia amang'ana ayio."

src_text: "Be cautious of agents offering NHIF registration at matatu stages. Report such individuals to the nearest police post. NHIF registration is free."
tgt_text: "Kabe maiso korwa abanto bagwekora ng'a nkorika bare ase omoroberio bweinsuarensi ya nyagitari (NHIF) abwo ase chirori chikorinerwa. Ripoti abanto abwo ase eporisi ere ange naye. Kwerika koba oyomo ase Einsuarensi ya Nyagitari (NHIF) mbosa egokorwa."

src_text: "The Ministry of Education reiterates that bursary forms are distributed freely and do not require payment. Any demand for money should be reported."
tgt_text: "Eminisitiri yechisemi yabekire chinguru nga chibasari chiesukuru nigo chikorugwa bosa fnaigo tegaineirie nga oakane. Gosabwa besa chinde chionsi nere buya korwaipoti."

src_text: "We urge Kenyans to double-check the legitimacy of any NGO requesting donations via mobile payment. Many have been flagged for fraud."
tgt_text: "Nigo togosaba abakenya koirorera gocheki oboamaene bwebiombe bia NGO dchigosaba ogokonya goetera entaneti. Chinyinge chiechio chianyorirwe koba echioboibi"

src_text: Do not give your M-PESA PIN to anyone! This is a very common scam.
tgt_text: Tobaisa korwa epini ya M-PESA yaogochia ase onde bwensi! Eye nero enchera abange baibeirwe.

src_text: Enable two-factor authentication (2FA) for all bank and social media accounts.
tgt_text: Enable two-factor authentication (2FA) for all bank and social media accounts.

src_text: Beware of emails pretending to be from banks asking for account verification.
tgt_text: Beware of emails pretending to be from banks asking for account verification.

src_text: Use a strong password like 'Nairobi2023!/' that is not easy to crack.
tgt_text: Tumia enomba yesiri enkongu okoigorera esimi yao buna Gusii2025! Eyio etari raisi ase monto onde koigora.

src_text: Never click on suspicious links like 'Youve won KSh 100,000!' in SMS.
tgt_text: Tobaisa kobata eraini yeintaneti orechitangutangu nero buna eria ekogotebi ng'a kwanyorire chibesa 100,000!' goetera amangana ameng'e eyesimi.

src_text: Update your phones software monthly to fix security vulnerabilities.
tgt_text: Kera engaki tema gokora keboyia einchini yesimi yao kera omotienyi erio koyerenda korwa okoriegwa nebinyinyi.

src_text: If your child is being bullied online, report it to the DCI Cyber ​​Unit immediately!
tgt_text: Onye omwana oo ogochandwa, kogoswa gose koramwa goetera eintaneti, manyia omonene bwobotuki otari konyorwa!

src_text: Avoid using public Wi-Fi for banking. Hackers can steal your data.
tgt_text: Tiga gotumia chisimi gose eintaneti kobeka gose gotoma chibesa gochia akaonti yao yebengi. Gokora igo nigo okorwa ribaga abaibi bare nobang'aini bwogosoa eintaneti yao na gokoibera ase obowororo.

src_text: Check 'Serena_254's' profile to see if it's legit before accepting the friend request.
tgt_text: Risegereria komanya inki 'Serena_254's' erengete nyuma otarakora kende nabarabwo.

src_text: Use a VPN on public networks to encrypt your internet traffic.
tgt_text: Tumia chinamba chiesiri ekero ogosoa ase Wi-Fi yabanto bonsi erio bwerende korwa abant barengete koyetuka komanya ninki kere ime.

src_text: Lock SIM yako kwa *something#! Usiache mtu atumie line yako kufanya maovu.
tgt_text: Sieka ESIM kadi yesimi yao buna *gentogete#! Totigera omonto atumie eraini yesimi yao gokora obobe

src_text: Monitor bank statements for unauthorized transactions weekly.
tgt_text: Mongera buna chibesa chia chigosoa na gosoka kera ewiki ase akaonti yebengi yao erio onyare komanya bwango boibi bonde bwonsi bobaise kobao.

src_text: Use biometrics (fingerprint/face ID) instead of PINs where possible.
tgt_text: Tumia egento buna ekiara kiao gose epicha yobosio bwao rika ria enamba yesiri ase ekonyarekana.

src_text: Ignore messages like 'Youve won Safaricom Jackpot!'Theyre scams.
tgt_text: Ombia amang'ana ameng'e esimi buna 'Kwabuire ejakipoti ya Safaricom' Aya namangana arengete gokoibera.

src_text: Encrypt sensitive files before sharing them online.
tgt_text: Amanagana ao obobisi yakeborane gochia enkwana yobobisi otayarasanga ase eintaneti.

src_text: Don't use the same password for Gmail, Facebook, and bank! If hacked, they'll all be gone.
tgt_text: Totumia enamba yesiri eyemo ase esimi, ebengi, akaonti ya Gmail, sose Facebook! Omonto aise gwesoi ase akaonti yao, onso aria kwabwate aroro nigo agosira pi na tokoyanyora rinde.

src_text: Verify charities before donating online.Fake fundraisers are common.
tgt_text: Kongoria buya ebiombe biria bigosaba ogokonywa goetera eintaneti otararwa besa ende yonsi. Abarigia chibesa boborimo nao bare.

src_text: Install antivirus software to protect against malware and spyware.
tgt_text: Beka egento keria kegotanga ebinyinyi ase esimi nekombiuta yao koyerenda korwa ebinyinyi bia malware na spyware.

src_text: Avoid 'get rich quick' schemes promising high returns.Theyre Ponzi scams.
tgt_text: Tiga kongaineka ng'a notenke bwango' emeroberio amangana akogotebia obwaita bwa bwango. Obo noborimo.

src_text: Secure home Wi-Fi with a strong password like 'Jamhuri@1963'.
tgt_text: tanga abanto korwa eWi-Fi yao ya nka goetera ringana rikingu kwegia buna'Jamhuri@1963'.

src_text: Turn off your Bluetooth when you're not using it! Others can access your phone.
tgt_text: Rimia eBluetooth yao ekero otari koyetumia. Abanto bande bensemo nabo barosoe ase esimi yao otamanyanyeti.

src_text: Check for 'https://' and a padlock icon before entering payment details online.
tgt_text: Rigereria 'https://' amo nekeogorero kiaye nyuma otarabeka gose goskana chisebesa goetera eintaneti.

src_text: Use privacy screens on laptops in public to prevent shoulder surfing.
tgt_text: Tumia ekerore ase ekombiuta yao yakoboko ekerore monto onde ore ange naye atanyarekorora eki okorikagose gwancha monto abekerere gento igoro ase ekombiuta yao. Eyio nabe arabe enchera eyemo yomoiba amangana ao gose kokoibera chibesa.

src_text: Don't use 'Mothers maiden name' for security questions! Use a fictional answer.
tgt_text: Tobaisa gotumia erieta riorera ria mama omino buna ring'ana ria riobobisi bwesimi gose ekombiuta. Tumia erieta riokwebaka orayare koinyora.

src_text: Fake DHL parcel alerts are common scams.Verify via official customer service.
tgt_text: Amanagana agokomanyia igoro yemesigo yoborimo goetera DHL nenchera eyemo abanto bakongainwa. Rigia komanya buya emeremo ekambani eyio egokora.

src_text: Do not open the 'Free Movies' USB on your computer! It may contain a virus.
tgt_text: Tobaise koigora gose kobeka chisiinema chia bosa ase ekombiuta yao goetera egento keria gekogacha chisinema gekorokwa eflash! Nabo keeranyare gosaria ekombiuta yao goetera ebinyinyi eflash ebogoretie.

src_text: Use incognito mode on shared devices to avoid saving browsing history.
tgt_text: Ekero ogotumia ekombiuta yeintaneti, yebeke tabaisa kogacha eki kware korora gose gosoma ekero gwasiekire eki kware gokora. Renda gotagacha eki ogokora ase ase ekombiuta.

src_text: If you are looking for customer support, use the numbers on the company's website.
tgt_text: Onye gokorigia ogokonywa korwa ekambani, tumia chinamba chiesimi gose eintaneti yekambani.

src_text: Disable browser password-saving features to protect accounts if your device is stolen.
tgt_text: Tobaise gwanchera ekombiuta okogachere ringangana riao riobobisi koyeigora erio korenda amagnana ase ekonbiuta eise koibwa gose gosira.

src_text: Visit rental properties in person. Online listings can be fake.
tgt_text: Tarera chinyomba chigokomboa aye omonyene. Amangana goetera eintaneti nabo arabe oborimo.

src_text: Download apps only from official stores like Google Play or Apple App Store.
tgt_text: Nyora ebinto biria bigokonya esimi gose ekombiuta gokora emeremo korwa aase egenire buna Google Play gose Apple App Store.

src_text: Use ad blockers to stop malicious pop-ups like 'Youve won an iPhone!'.
tgt_text: Tumia egento kegotanga amangana ogotangasa ebiasara buan kwanyorire esimi iPhone eye nencher eyemo yogotanga ebinyibigosaria esimi giose ekombiuta yao.

src_text: Check email sender addresses for typos like 'support@paypa1.com' (scam!).
tgt_text: Rora buya ng'a ningo otomete eimeil komanya eyebingainereria buna 'support@paypa1.com' (Oboibi!).

src_text: "Do not download apps from random websites. Always use Google Play Store or Apple App Store. Unverified apps may contain malware."
tgt_text: "Tiga korusia ebikoreri biria bigonya esimi gokora egasi korwa eintaneti aende yonsi. Kera engaki binyore korwa Google Play Store gose Apple App Store".

src_text: Avoid using public Wi-Fi for banking. Use a VPN if you must connect. Most free networks are not secure."
tgt_text: "Erende korwa eWi-Fi yabanto bonsi kobeka chibesa ebengi. Tumia a VPN onye gokonyara gosoa ime. Chinetewaki chinyinge chia bosaare nchibwati borendi buya."

src_text: Do not share your MPESA PIN with anyone. Safaricom and banks will never ask for it. If in doubt, call official support.
tgt_text: Tobaisa gosanga enemba yao yobobisi ya MPESA nonde bwensi. Safaricom gose ebengi mbarikobori koboria nga obayetebie. Ekero ore nechitangutangu yeringana erio, rangeria ebengi yao koboria buya okonywe.

src_text: "Set up 2FA (Two-Factor Authentication) for all your accounts. If your password is stolen, you will still be protected."
tgt_text: "Eroserie 2FA (Chinchera ibera komnya buya) buna chiakaonti chiao ebengi chigendererete. Onye ringana riao riobobisi riaibirwe, nobe kwerendete ekiagera orosetie 2FA."

src_text: Always wear a helmet when riding a bodaboda - it saves lives!
tgt_text: Kera engaki beka ehofia eri egokorende ekero kiomobasekano korinete epigipigi - ngokonya ere obogima!

src_text: Don't use your phone while walking on the road! Look both ways before crossing the road.
tgt_text: Tiga gotara kogotumia esimi ekero ore epara! Rigereria rigoro na maata otarantamboka.

src_text: Keep children away from open flames and hot surfaces in the kitchen.
tgt_text: Beka abana are korwa ase omorero ore gose ebinto bigosamba aaria echikoni.

src_text: Install barriers on windows and doors on upper floors to prevent children from falling.
tgt_text: Sambereria gose beka ase emerangwa nechitirisa ase enyoba yeekorofa ebinto bigokonya gotanga abana tibagwa inse.

src_text: Never leave children unattended near water bodies - drowning happens silently.
tgt_text: Tobaisa gotiga abana boka aase amache amange are - okonywa chintobe nigo ekoba raisi otamanyeti.

src_text: Use crossing points and traffic lights where available.
tgt_text: Tumia gotamboka epara aase ebimanyererio bibekire gose chitochi chikogotebia ekero obwenerete gotamboka epara.

src_text: Install smoke detectors in your home for early fire warnings.
tgt_text: Beka ebinto biria bikonyonka erioki ase enyomba yao gokomanyia bwango elero enyomba yabwatire omorero oyorimie bwango.

src_text: Keep a first aid kit at home and learn basic first aid procedures.
tgt_text: Kabe namariogo nyomba aria aragokonye gokonyera oborwaire bwa mobasekano gose omonto oumiire otaramoikia nyagitari.

src_text: Always check expiry dates on food products to avoid food poisoning.
tgt_text: Kera engaki mongera chitariki chiendagera kogunda otaragora erio bwerende gotara na koria endagera eng'undo ekoretere obokong'u.

src_text: If you see a power cable fallen, stay away and call 999 immediately.
tgt_text: Korarore omorande bwesitima ogwete inse, toika ang,e rangeria enamba ya morero ya porisi 999 otari konyorwa.

src_text: Secure heavy furniture to walls to prevent tip-over accidents with children.
tgt_text: Torerania ebinto buna eborogo gose chimesa chidito nyomba ase chinyasi gokonya hitichigwera abana ekero bagotema korina igoro.

src_text: Do not use gas stoves indoors - keep them in a well-ventilated area.
tgt_text: Tiga gotumia eagsi gotugera nyombe ase etirisa gose morangwa otari koreta embeo nyomba - yetumie ase aigogete embeo egosoa buya.

src_text: Learn basic swimming skills - it could save your life or someone else's.
tgt_text: Egegera buna oranyare goaka ontimbu -nabo eragokonye gose gokonya omonto onde.

src_text: Teach children their full names, parents' contacts, and home address.
tgt_text: Egeria abana komanya amarieta abo onsi, enamba yesimi, inka sobo buna ekorokwa, agose enamba yeposita yerirube.

src_text: Keep emergency exits open and unblocked in shops and offices.
tgt_text: Manyia gose orokereria buya aase abanto bakominchoreria gochia ekero kiobokongu na koyatiga aigoire chingaki chionsi egasi egenderete.

src_text: Never overload electrical sockets - it can cause fires.
tgt_text: Tiga gotumba ebinto ebinge ase esoketi eyemo yesitima -eye nabo erabe enchera eyemo yomorero gwateka nyomba.

src_text: Always wear seatbelts - front and back seats - on every trip.
tgt_text: Siba omchibi kore erori ime chingaki chionsi - nyuma na magega kera engaki egari ekogenda.

src_text: Do not allow children to play near stones during construction.
tgt_text: Totiga abana gotienera ase amagena are ekero amaagacho agendererete.

src_text: Keep emergency numbers visible in your home and workplace.
tgt_text: Beka chinamba chiria chiemebasekano ase chikororekana buya chinka chiaino na ase emeremo.

src_text: Create a family emergency plan and meeting point for disasters.
tgt_text: Manyererania genkio nabanto benyoma yao aase ogotamera chingaki chiomobasekano.

src_text: Do not use damaged or burning electrical appliances.
tgt_text: Tobaisa gotumia ebinto biesitima bisaregete gose bigisamba.

src_text: Learn the Heimlich maneuver to help someone who's choking.
tgt_text: Soma na komanya igoro ya Heimlich maneuver erio omanye buna orkonye omonto ongentirwe nandagera gose amache.

src_text: Put covers on unused electrical outlets, especially in homes with children.
tgt_text: Tibua ande onsi aase esitima egosokera buna chisoketi, mono kegima ase chinka chire nabana.

src_text: Never leave candles burning unattended - use hurricane lamps instead.
tgt_text: Totiga omosuma ogwoka bwoka monto taiyo korora buna ogwoka - tumia etaya nyakio rika riomosuma.

src_text: Always check weather forecasts before planning outdoor activities.
tgt_text: Rigereria buya rire buna rire otarasoka kogenda gose gosoka gochia esafari.

src_text: Install carbon monoxide detectors if you use gas or kerosene heaters.
tgt_text: Beka egento keria gekonyonka embeo embe onye kogotumia amaguta etaya gose egasi.

src_text: Never drink and drive - even small amounts of alcohol impair judgment.
tgt_text: Tonywa amarwa naende ogendie erori - nanya namarwa amake igo nigo agosaria ebirengererio nachisemi eki obwenerete gokora.

src_text: Teach children how to call for help in emergencies (999 or 112).
tgt_text: Somia abana bamanye buna baranyare krigia ogokonya ekero kiemebasekano goetera (999 gose 112).

src_text: Do not leave dangerous items within the reach of young children.
tgt_text: Tiga kobeka ebinto bire atari ase abana ase baranyare kobikera.

src_text: If you have farms, clearly label fertilizers and pesticides.
tgt_text: Onye kobwate omogondo bwoboremi, orokereria buya obwoyo mborobi, n amariogo boigo.

src_text: Never use generators indoors - they produce deadly carbon monoxide.
tgt_text: Tobaisa kobeka echenereta nyomba na koyiokia - erioki riaye nesumu ase omobere.

src_text: Use sunscreen and avoid the sun between 10 am and 4 pm.
tgt_text: Use sunscreen and avoid the sun between 10 am and 4 pm.

src_text: Always check depth before diving into water - neck injuries can be fatal.
tgt_text: Kera engaki pima komanya obotambe bwamache otarasoa goaka ontimbu. - nabo oraumie bobe ebigoti.

src_text: Do not leave cooking utensils uncovered when using cooking oil.
tgt_text: Kunekeri chufuguri ekero ogotumia amaguta amaguta ogokaranga endagera.

src_text: Learn basic first aid for burns, cuts, and choking incidents.
tgt_text: Manya chinchera chia bwango buna oranyare gokora ekero kwayire, kwenachire gose kwangentirwe nandagera gose amache.

src_text: Emergency contacts are: Police (999), Ambulance (911), Fire (990).
tgt_text: Chinamba chiemebasekano: Porisi (999), Erori ya Ambulance (911), Omorero bwatekire (990).

src_text: Never leave children alone in vehicles - temperatures rise dangerously fast.
tgt_text: Totiga abana boka erori ime - riberera ime yorori nigo rikomenta bwango.

src_text: Use easy-opening windows in bedrooms for emergencies.
tgt_text: Beka chitirisa chikoigoka kebwororo ase chinyomba chiokorara koba aororo ekero kiemebasekano kominchoria.

src_text: Always have a working flashlight and extra batteries at home.
tgt_text: Kera engaki tema koba netochi inka orayare gwokia ekero esitima yagendire amao nasasi ande oranyare koyebeka ekro aria are ime aerire.

src_text: Keep an emergency contact list on the fridge and with your older children.
tgt_text: Rika chinamba orarangerie onyore ogokonya ase egento keria kegokendia endagera (efurichi) amo nabana bao abanene.

src_text: Report suspicious activities in your neighborhood to police immediately.
tgt_text: mnyia amangan ore nechitangutangu naro agokorekeka ase chiamate chiao gochia ase omogambi gose abasikari kegima.

src_text: Don't display valuables in your car - keep them out of sight.
tgt_text: Tiga kworokia ebinto bierigori ime yerori yao - keep them outside.

src_text: Join or start a neighborhood watch program in your area.
tgt_text: Join or start a neighborhood watch program in your area.

src_text: Take photos of your valuables and record serial numbers for identification.
tgt_text: Aka ebicha ebinto bia biengencho bionsi chibicha na rika chinamba chiokobiatanana.

src_text: Use strong padlocks for gates and sheds - avoid cheap, easy-to-cut locks.
tgt_text: Tumia ebiburi ebikong'u ase ebiita biao nekiriri igoro yabo - tga kogora ebinto biebei enke, bikobutoru naibaibi bwngo.

src_text: Be cautious about sharing travel plans on social media.
tgt_text: Tiga gwatora-tora emeroberio yechisfari chiao ase eintaneti.

src_text: Keep bushes and trees near windows trimmed to eliminate hiding spots.
tgt_text: Nacha emete na rabia orosana ase chitirisa gotanga abaibi tibebisa aroro.

src_text: Mark your property with UV pens or engraving to help recovery if stolen.
tgt_text: Beka ebinto biao nekemanyererio "UV pens or engraving" gokonya kobinyora onye biaibirwe.

src_text: Install peepholes in exterior doors to identify visitors before opening.
tgt_text: Bochora ebingoro biabeene ase emerangu yaisiko kogokonya korora nakomanya omonto korwa nyomba otaramogorera.

src_text: Teach domestic staff to verify identities before opening gates/doors.
tgt_text: Somia abakori emeremo bao ba nka korigereria buya ebibande bia'bageni nyuma batarabaigoreraebiita gose omorangu.

src_text: Use timers for lights when away to give appearance someone is home.
tgt_text: Ekero gwasokire gochia esafari, beka chitochi chia chiesitima chinsa chireokie chinyene buna egento giokworokia nga omonto nare nka.

src_text: Keep car keys in a secure location at home, not near doors/windows.
tgt_text: Gacha ebibunguo bierori yao inka ase agiya, korende tari ase omorangu gose etirisa.

src_text: Verify credentials of service personnel before allowing access to property.
tgt_text: Verify credentials of service personnel before allowing access to property.

src_text: Install security cameras at entry points and make them visible.
tgt_text: Beka chikamera chikobwata buna abanto bagosoa na gosoka korwa bwoo as omorangu gose egeita hirirekanete buya.

src_text: Be aware of common scams like fake lottery winnings or inheritance claims.
tgt_text: Erende korwa ebinto biobongainereria buna kong'ainwa ng'a kwabuire bahati na sibu buna omonyamwando bwomonto osirete.

src_text: Keep emergency numbers programmed in your phone for quick access.
tgt_text: Rika na kogacha esimi yaoime chinamba orarangerie chingaki chiemebasakano.

src_text: Use different routes when traveling regularly to avoid establishing patterns.
tgt_text: Etera chinhera ao ao echi ogosokera korwa inka na koirana erio osirerio amabarato yorogendo rwao buna enchera eyemo yokwerenda.

src_text: Shred documents containing personal information before disposal.
tgt_text: Tandora na gosria gose samba amasakara ao abwate amang'ana bobisi otarayatuguta.

src_text: Join us in the fight against corruption. Be part of the solution.
tgt_text: Tobwatisies ase ekinano nobokengeka. Kabe oyomo ase okoreta ekeganeirie.

src_text: Corruption weakens counties. Ttake a stand! Uphold ethics in public service and support anti-graft initiatives.
tgt_text: Obokorekanu nigo bokogengeria chinguru chiense. Chora buya! Segeta na goikerania obokereri obuya ase na sira emeroberio yokorwania obokorekanu.

src_text: Every Kenyan must join the fight against corruption.Uuphold our dignity and justice.
tgt_text: Nere buya kera omo'Kenya kobwatisia esegi gotanga obokorekanu. Segeta amasikani nekeene.

src_text: Urgent reforms at Kenya Power & Lighting Company (KPLC) are vital to restore public trust. Be part of the change.
tgt_text: Oboonchoreria bwa bwango ase ekambani yesitima ya Kenya (KPLC) nayengencho ase okoirania obwegenwa gati yekambani eyio yomorero nabanto ba Kenya. Kabe oyomo ase baria bakorenta amaonchorerio.

src_text: Automation of the self-declaration process is now live. Uphold integrity by complying online today.
tgt_text: Okwemanyekania aye omonyene igoro yenibo obwate bono nigo ogekorwa goetera egedichitri gose eintaneti. Segeta obokeene ase ogoikerania ayio goetera eintaneti.

src_text: Embrace innovation for greater impact. Ethical leadership starts with you.
tgt_text: Bwata chinchera chinyia chiogokora emeremo ase obokoreri oboikeranu. Engencho engiya nigo egochaka naye.

src_text: Unified action is needed in the war against graft. Stand firm, report corruption.
tgt_text: Okobwatera amo nkoganeirie erio gosegeta esegi ase obokorekanu. Tenena bokong'u, teba ase obokorekanu bore.

src_text: Search warrants are investigative tools, not criminal proceedings. Uphold the law, uphold integrity.
tgt_text: Abasikari gocha kogotuka buna koti yabatomete nokorigia obosaiti, na tari ekina kiobosaria. Sika richiko, kabe nekeene.

src_text: Keep our roads safe. Corruption in licensing and inspections is “licensing to kill.” Report bribery in transport.
tgt_text: Bwatia amachiko obogendi chirori gotanga emebasekano. Konyora erensesi yokogendi erori ase obokengeka gose eroi yao koegwa amarube yoborigereria nga mbuya ere yoborimo “nokorwa erensesi yogoita.” Teba igoro yokoria riaki ase obobogoria.

src_text: Join our outreach in Nandi County: raise awareness, promote ethics, and stand with us against graft.
tgt_text: Inchuo naintwe ase ogoikera abanto isiko gokwanerana aiga ekaonti yaito ya Nandi: manyia abanto, segeta chingencho chingiya, na tenena naintwe korwania obokengeka.

src_text: Be cautious of strangers asking for personal or financial information.
tgt_text: Erende korwa abanto otamanyeti bagokobori amangana igoro yao gose chibesa chiao.

src_text: Install window security film to make glass harder to break.
tgt_text: Sambereria chichuma ase chetirisa chia erio gotanga ebirore tibiateka raisi.

src_text: Don't leave ladders or tools outside that could help burglars gain access.
tgt_text: Totuiga engasi gose kende gionsi keranyare gokonya abaibi korina mwao ase ekorofa na kogoikera.

src_text: Keep car doors locked and windows up when driving in high-risk areas.
tgt_text: Sieka emerangu yerori yao na koyeroki buya ekero okogendia erori yao ase chirori nabanto bare abange gose obosaria bwa igoro.

src_text: Use tracking devices for valuable items like electronics and vehicles.
tgt_text: Beka erori yao ebinto biria biranyare koyebwatia gose koyerora ase ere ekero yaibirwe nebinto binde bia bionsi biingencho.

src_text: Be wary of strangers offering unsolicited help with ATMs or banking.
tgt_text: Eborie buya igoro tabanto otamanyeti bakorwa ogokonya kwa bosa goetera obokoreri bwechisimi, (ATMs) gose ebengi.

src_text: Create inventory of household items with photos and receipts for insurance.
tgt_text: Rika inse ebinto bionsi bia mwao. biake chibicha na gacha amarisiti kwabigorerete gonya insuarensi kogoakana ekero birayie gose koibwa.

src_text: Use deadbolt locks on exterior doors for added security.
tgt_text: Use deadbolt locks on exterior doors for added security.

src_text: Install motion-activated lights in dark areas around your property.
tgt_text: Beka ase enkna yao gose ase enibo yao ere ebirobu biesitima biria ekero biarorire omonto botuko bigwoka gokomanyia nga onto nare isiko.

src_text: Don't leave spare keys in obvious places like under doormats or flowerpots.
tgt_text: Totiba ekopi yebinguo biao bia kobera aase aamo engaki entambe buna inse yomogeka bwenyomba gose ase enyongo yamaoga - bichenchie kera engaki.

src_text: Use security bars or grilles on vulnerable windows and doors.
tgt_text: Sambereria egiriri ase chitirisa nemerangu gochikong'ia.

src_text: Be alert in parking lots - have keys ready and check backseat before entering.
tgt_text: Be alert in parking lots - have keys ready and check backseat before entering.

src_text: The Police Service urges Patriotic Kenyans to report cases of illegal immigrants for arrest to the nearest police stations.
tgt_text: Abasikari baboririe abakenya baria banhete ense yabo Kenya bamanyie igoro yabanto bakagere gosoa Kenya goetera emerangu ya magega gochia eporisi steseni ya ange babwatwe.

src_text: We urge citizens to continue volunteering information that will lead to the arrest of Francis Gaitho.
tgt_text: Nigo togosaba abanainchi bagenderere korwa amang'ana gochia ase abasikari aranyare gokonya komobwata Francis Gaitho.

src_text: Let's continue playing our part in thwarting terror by sharing information on suspicious activities with relevant authorities.
tgt_text: Kera oyomo oito atigare koba maiso nagokora ensemo yaye gotanga obokebago bwokoruta chipomuin goetera akomanyania amang'ana gose ebinto tore nechitangutangu nabirobio.

src_text: If you have information, #ReachDCI through hotline number 0800 722 203. Let's work together to uphold justice and accountability. #FichuaGaitho
tgt_text: Onye kore nering'ana, #Moikera omotuki omonene goetera enamba ya morero 0800 722 203. Tiga tokore emeremo amo gosegeta ekeene nobotenereri obuya. #Bisora Gaitho

src_text: The public is advised to exercise restrain and is explicitly cautioned against any attempts to enter without authorisation or break into JKIA as it is a protected zone under the laws of Kenya.
tgt_text: Abanto basemiigwe gwetanga koba nobororo na gokurerwa kegima ng'a tibatema kobuna egeita na gosoa nechinguru egetii kene giechindege gia Jomo Kennyatta International Airport (JKIA) egekogera aiga naase arendire nerichiko ria Kenya.

src_text: Youths are advised to reject alshabaab propaganda to avoid premature death or such hefty jail sentences.
tgt_text: Abasae basemiigwe kwanga amangana alshabaab aporopaganda gotanga ogokwa kwabwango buna etarenge engencho yogokwa gose gosibwa echera engaki entambe.

src_text: Citizens are advised to avoid buying phones from random people as Telcos and Security Agencies are tracking the stolen devices.
tgt_text: Abanainchi basemiigwe gotanga gotaboria chisimi korwa ase abantoekiageraekambani eria yarosetie chisimi echio nabasikari nkobwatia bare chisimi chibire.

src_text: Let's work with Police to arrest criminals hiding in #Maandamano to steal, destroy properties and commit other crimes.
tgt_text: Tiga tokore emeremo amo nabasikari kobwata ebibago biebisete ase amaanadamano erio koiba, dgosaria ebinto kobakora abande koba ebibago.

src_text: Let's avoid sharing propaganda, unverified information, and graphic images in order not to add to the distress of the affected.
tgt_text: Totige korandarandia amangana yoborimo, amangana ataramanyekana boronge, amo nechibicha erio titoba abakogesa obororo ase baria bare nobokong'u.

src_text: Disturbance of peace, incitement, looting, and vandalism remain unlawful.
tgt_text: Ogoturubania omorembe, ogosegeta abanto, okiba, na gosaria ebinto nigo bire mamincha yerichiko.

src_text: Verify identity of delivery personnel before allowing access to property.
tgt_text: Rigereria buya ekabande kiomonto ogokoba gose korenta ebinto buya nyuma otaramwanchera gosoa.

src_text: Don't leave valuables visible in your car when parked.
tgt_text: Totiga ebinto biengencho birorekane ime yerori yao ekero oyeteneneties ase chirori chikobekwa.

src_text: Use steering wheel locks as additional deterrent for vehicle theft.
tgt_text: Sieka gose richania egento keria kierori omorundia erori agotumia goonchorana amagoro gakoyegendi (Obureki) buna enchera eyo yogotanga teibwa.

src_text: Be cautious of 'distraction theft' tactics in public places.
tgt_text: Tigara komanyete buna abaibi chingencho abaibi bagotumia ase abanto bare abange koiba.

src_text: Keep emergency numbers visible near phones and programmed in mobile devices.
tgt_text: Rika na kobeka chinamba chiesimi ase chikororekana buya mbarabare nesimi yao echio chirangerigwe ekero kiomobaseka konyora obokonyi visible.

src_text: Consider installing a safe for important documents and valuables.
tgt_text: Nere buya koba nase agiya okobeka amanag'ana ao na ebinto biaobiengencho.

src_text: Be wary of 'emergency' scams where callers pretend to be family in distress.
tgt_text: Kabe maiso nechisimi korwa ase abanto bagwekona buna abamo babamino chigokorangeria nga omonto omino nare ase emechando eganetie oboknyi bwa bwango gokonya obogima bwaya.

src_text: Use security chains on doors even when expecting visitors.
tgt_text: Sieka emerangu yao yenyomba nenyororo nonya nekero okagerete abageni gocha kogokwania.

src_text: Be cautious of 'shoulder surfing' at ATMs and when entering PINs.
tgt_text: kabe maiso ase emachini eria ekorusia chibesa ase ebengi na abanto bakoigoka ang'e okobata PIN emachine ekoe chibesa.

src_text: Use security cameras with cloud storage to preserve evidence if needed.
tgt_text: Beka chikamera chiria chibwatanirie neintaneti chikobwata abanto buna bagosoa na gosoka gose ebinto bigendererete kogonya obosaiti ekero boganeirie.

src_text: Usifanye maonyesho ya mali thamani kwa umma - weka kwa siri na salama.
tgt_text: Tobaise kworokia enibo yao ore nero ase abanto- yegache ase obobisi na buya.

src_text: Install security film on glass doors to prevent easy break-ins.
tgt_text: Beka egamu gatigati yebirore bierori yao gotanga abaibi kobwata ase obwororo.

src_text: Put unique marks on your belongings to easily identify them if they are stolen.
tgt_text: Beka ekemayererio kia beene ase ebinto biao erio onyare kobiatanana buya ekero biabirwe.

src_text: Keep car registration and insurance documents secure, not in glove compartment.
tgt_text: Gacha amasakara kwagorerete erori yao amo neinsuarensi kafa yerori yao ase agaya , na tari ase erori yao ome.

src_text: Be cautious of 'too good to be true' offers for rentals or purchases.
tgt_text: Kabe maiso nebinto bikororekana buya na buna ebiekeene bikorugwa ogore enyomba aase gete.

src_text: Consider joining or forming a business watch program in commercial areas.
tgt_text: Nere buya kobwatana nabanyabiasara ase oborendi bwebiasara biano aaria ase ebiasara.

src_text: Contact emergency services through: Police (999), DCI (0800 722 203).
tgt_text: Ikera ogokonywa chingaki chiemebasekano goetera: Porisi (999), Omotuki omonene (0800 722 203).

src_text: Be cautious of strangers asking to use your phone for 'emergencies'.
tgt_text: Erende nabanto otamanyeti bakogosaba esimi yao baake ase ingana rinde rionsi riomobasekano'.

tgt_text: Abasikari bobokoreri (APS) baeire abarendi boborendi buna babwenerete gokora mechando ende meke goetera chinkwana erio gokora eminano.

tgt_text: Ekeombe kia baria bagokora amaonchorerio ase obokoreri bwabasikari nigo kegosaba ogokongigwa kwa abarendi boborendi (COP)

tgt_text: Eripoti ya ayarorekanete goikerwa naobokoreri bwa Nyumba Kumi aaria ekaonti ya Migori (Suna West).

tgt_text: Obokongoria bwa KIPPRA igoro yamaonchorerio igoro yabarendi boborendi.

tgt_text: Ayanyorekanete arengete abarendi boborendi ase emechie yechirandi aaria Nairobikoreng'ana na ayare aaria Nakuru engima.

tgt_text: Engencho engiya yechikomiti chia abarendi boborendi aaria omochie o'Narumoru station (Obokoreri bwakaonti ya Nyeri), bwasiretwe na IMLU, kobwaterana nabarai bebinyoro.

tgt_text: Ekeombe kia IMLU kiarure eripoti igoro yechikomoti chiabarendi boborendi aaria Narumoru (egokorera ensemo ya Nyandarua)

tgt_text: Abarendi boborendi bekaonti ya Machakosyamanyirie ng'a ogkeania obosaria kwarorekanire aaria ensemo ya Mwala.

src_text: Mombasa community policing forum convened by KEPSSI and local leaders to curb juvenile gangs in Likoni
tgt_text: Ogocha amo kwabarendi boborendi aaria ekaonti ya Mombasa gwakoretwe nekeombe keria kiobomo bwechisukuru chioboroso (KEPSSI) ase okobwaterana nabarai bebinyoro gokinana na ebiombe biobosaria nabana abake aaria Likoni

tgt_text: ekeombe keria kiobomo bwechisukuru chioboroso (KEPSSI) nkiabwateranete nekeombe kiabanyanyimbo (NPS) kuorokereria ekamati yabarendi ase ekenyoro

src_text: Research showing how police community collaboration contributed to crime reduction in Machakos Sub County
tgt_text: Obotuki bokoorokia buna okobwaterana gwe ekenyoro na eserekari biorokiri gokei obosaria

src_text: Academic findings on drivers of COP success and constraints in Migori County's Nyumba Kumi program
tgt_text: Amasomo abeene aorokirie buna omosangerekano bwabasangi ase oborendi (COP) bwakonyire gokeania emechando aaria ekaonti ya Migori goetera omoroberio O'Nyumba Kumi.

src_text: Outline of training programs for police and community defenders in Kisumu, Mombasa, Nakuru, prior to national elections
tgt_text: Ngwatora ere emeroberio yokwegeria as abasikari nabaegereri bebinyoro aaria Kisumu, Mombasa amo na' Nakuru ange nobochori obonene.

src_text: All 47 Kenyan county security committee members received training in community policing and prevention of violent extremism
tgt_text: Abarendi boborendi bechikaonti chionsi 47 mbanyorete amasomo amao nabateneneri boborendi bebinyoro abanyene gotanga obosareki bwogoonchorwa ebirengererio.

src_text: KNCHR tells of citizen engagement programs boosting security and human rights awareness in Kisumu County
tgt_text: Ekeombe keria ekenene gia Kenya kerendete oboronge bwa mwanyabanto (KNCHR) ngoteba bare igoro yemeroberio yokobwaterana buna yakong'irie oborendi na obomanyi igoro yoboronge bwa mwanayabanto aaria ekaonti ya Kisumu
